title: Free Trial Period
content:
Overview
The Free Trial Period add-on allows administrators to offer a specified number of free days on individual paid membership plans. Depending on the website’s payment gateway and selected authorization option, members may be required to enter payment information during signup.
If a member does not cancel before the trial ends, the regular membership payment becomes due.
How To Get This Add-On
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available:
Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually:
Free Trial Period Add-On
Features and Benefits
:
Increase paid membership signups
Add a free trial period to individual membership packages.
Choose how many days the trial period lasts
Trial info is automatically displayed on checkout pages
Payment information can be optional or required, depending on the selected authorization option and payment gateway.
Members are automatically charged once their trial ends
Members are not charged if they cancel before their trial ends
How to Enable a Free Trial for a Membership Plan
1. Open the Membership Plan
Go to
Finance » Membership Plans
.
Click
Edit
for the membership plan that will offer the trial.
2. Open the Sign Ups & Upgrades Tab
Select the
Sign Ups & Upgrades
tab.
3. Enable the Free Trial Period
Two sets of options are available and can be configured independently:
New Signups:
For members subscribing to this plan for the first time.
Plan Changes:
For existing members switching from another plan to this one.
For either option, set
Enable Free Trial Period
to
Yes
.
4. Specify Number of Trial Days
In
Number of Free Trial Days
, enter the duration of the trial. For example, enter
7
to offer a seven-day free trial. Click
Save Changes
when the configuration is complete.
Credit Card Requirements and Authorization Options
Under
Free Trial Additional Options
, select how payment information will be handled during the free trial. The available options depend on whether the website uses an on-site or off-site payment gateway.
Related Article:
Supported Payment Gateways: On-Site and Off-Site Payment Gateways
Off-Site Payment Gateways
No credit card required for free trial:
Members can begin the free trial without providing payment information. They must add a valid payment method before paid billing can begin.
On-Site Payment Gateways
No credit card required for free trial:
Members can begin the free trial without providing payment information. They must add a valid payment method before paid billing can begin.
Add credit card on file without authorization:
Members must provide a credit card during signup. The card is saved but is not charged or authorized until the free trial ends.
Authorize a $1.00 charge when card is required:
Members must provide a credit card. A $1 authorization is processed to verify that the card is valid and active.
Authorize full subscription amount when card is required:
Members must provide a credit card. The full subscription amount is authorized to confirm that sufficient funds are available. The regular payment is processed when the free trial ends.
What Members See at Checkout
When No Credit Card Is Required
Credit-card fields are hidden during checkout. The member must add a valid payment method before paid billing begins. If payment cannot be collected when the trial ends, the member is marked as
Past Due
.
When Authorization Is Required
When a credit-card authorization option is selected, the checkout form displays an authorization notice explaining how the member’s card will be handled.
Customize the Authorization Message
To customize the authorization title and message:
Go to
Settings » Text Labels
.
Search for
Credit Card Authorization
.
Edit the following labels:
Credit Card Authorization Title
Credit Card Authorization Message
Save the changes.
Verify the Free Trial for New Signups
After saving the membership plan, open its signup page to confirm that the free-trial information appears correctly.
Go to
Finance » Membership Plans
.
Find the configured membership plan and click
Edit
.
Click
Sign Up Page
at the top of the page.
In the
Select a Payment Option
section, confirm that the trial duration and payment start date are displayed correctly.
Verify the Free Trial During a Plan Upgrade
Free trials can also apply when an existing member upgrades to an eligible membership plan. The destination plan must have the free trial enabled and must be configured as an available upgrade option.
When the member selects the plan from the Upgrade/Downgrade page, the trial duration and payment start date appear with the plan’s payment information:
For instructions on making the plan available during an upgrade, see
How to Setup Upgrade/Downgrade Options for Membership Plans
.
Customize the Free Trial Display Text
When a free trial is enabled, the trial duration and payment start date appear during checkout:
To customize this text:
Go to
Settings » Text Labels
.
Search for
Free Trial
.
Edit the applicable labels.
Save the changes.
The following five labels are available for editing:
Label Description
Variable Name
Default Text
Line 1 Before Days
free_trial_period_line1_before
This plan includes a.
Line 1 After Days
free_trial_period_line1_after
DAY FREE TRIAL.
Line 2 Before Start Date
free_trial_period_line2_before
Your payment will start on.
Line 2 After Start Date
free_trial_period_line2_after
Type additional text if needed.
Line 3 (Additional Info)
free_trial_period_line3
Additional text displayed under date.
The “before” and “after” labels are combined with a dynamically generated value, such as the number of trial days or the payment start date.
Additional Notes
The following conditions apply when using the Free Trial Period Add-On:
Members must cancel before the trial ends to avoid the first regular membership charge.
Free trials can apply to both new signups and eligible membership-plan upgrades.
When no card is collected during signup, the member must add a valid payment method before paid billing begins.
If payment cannot be collected when the trial ends, the member is marked
Past Due
.
Past-due transactions can be reviewed under
Finance » Transaction History » Past Due
.
Additional Resources
Free Trial Payment Intents - Stripe
Finance » Transaction History

title: Account Details Section For Members
content:
Navigation Path:
Admin Dashboard » My Members » Search Members » Actions Dropdown » Account Details
The Account Details section provides a comprehensive administrative view of an individual member record. It is organized into seven tabs, each covering a distinct area of member data.
The seven tabs are:
Overview
Transactions
Subscriptions
Profile Analytics
Member Content
Activity
Member Reviews
Overview
The Overview tab presents a consolidated summary of the selected member's core account information, organized into the following sections:
Contact Information
— Displays the member's name, email address, phone number, and address details.
Membership Information
— Displays the member's assigned plan, account status, join date, and related account-level settings.
Lead Activity Stats
— Displays an at-a-glance summary of lead-related activity associated with the member's profile.
Internal Admin Notes
— Displays any notes entered for this member via the Internal Admin Notes field in the
Quick Edit Module
. These notes are visible only to administrators and are not displayed to the member or site visitors.
⚠ NOTE — Overview Is Read-Only:
No fields in the Overview tab are editable from this view. To modify contact or account information, use the Quick Edit module or the member's full Edit Profile section.
Transactions
The Transactions tab displays the complete payment and transaction history for the selected member. The layout and data format mirrors the global
Transaction History
view found under
Finance
, but is filtered to show records belonging to the selected member only.
The
CC Info
button allows the administrator to view and edit the credit card information on file for the selected member.
Reference:
CC Info
The
New Order
button allows the administrator to create a new order for the selected member directly from within the Transactions tab.
⚠ BEHAVIORAL NOTE — Button Availability Is Conditional:
The New Order button is only displayed when no active subscription exists for the member. When an active subscription is present, the transaction history is displayed without the New Order button. If a member's subscription has lapsed or was never created, the New Order button will appear in its place, allowing the administrator to initiate a new subscription for that member.
Subscriptions
The Subscriptions tab displays the complete subscription history for the selected member, including the active subscription record, billing cycle, next invoice date, and any coupon code applied at the time of signup (if applicable).
Selecting a coupon code displayed in this tab opens the coupon's configuration details.
The following subscription management actions are available via the
Actions
dropdown within this tab:
Action
Description
Edit Subscription
Allows modification of the member's active subscription settings.
Cancel Subscription
Initiates the cancellation of the member's active subscription.
References:
Edit Subscription
·
Cancel Subscription
⚠
NOTE — Cancellation Date Display:
When a subscription is cancelled, the Next Invoice Date field in the subscription record is replaced by the cancellation date. This is the system's indicator that no further billing cycles are scheduled for that subscription.
Profile Analytics
The Profile Analytics tab displays page visit statistics for the selected member's public profile, including visit counts broken down by month, year, and total cumulative visits.
⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Member Profile Analytics:
This tab is only visible when both of the following conditions are met:
The
Member Profile Analytics
add-on is active on the site.
The "Enable Profile Statistics" setting is enabled within the member's assigned Membership Plan settings.
If either condition is not met, the Profile Analytics tab will not appear in the Account Details section for that member.
Member Content
The Member Content tab displays all posts created by the selected member, including content that has not yet been published. The layout and available actions mirror the global
Manage Posts
view found under
My Content
, but is filtered to show only posts belonging to the selected member.
⚠ NOTE — Unpublished Content Is Visible Here:
This tab surfaces all content records for the member regardless of publication status. Unpublished, draft, and pending posts are displayed alongside published content. This is the recommended view for auditing a specific member's full content output
Activity
The Activity tab displays a chronological log of all recorded activity events for the selected member. The layout mirrors the global
Activity Tracker
found under
Dashboard
, but is scoped entirely to the selected member's account.
Activity records logged in this tab may include login events, profile updates, content submissions, and other system-tracked interactions associated with the member.
Member Reviews
The Member Reviews tab displays all reviews that have been submitted by site users for the selected member's profile. The layout mirrors the global
Member Reviews
view found under
My Members
, but is filtered to show only reviews associated with the selected member.
⚠ NOTE — Review Management:
Reviews can be moderated from this tab in the same manner as the global Member Reviews section. Any moderation actions taken here apply only to reviews associated with the selected member.

title: Quick Edit Module For Members
content:
The Quick Edit section for the members can be reached by navigating to:
My Members
Search Members
Quick Edit
under
Actions
dropdown
The Quick Edit module provides administrators with direct access to four management tabs for any individual member record without navigating away from the Search Members screen.
The four tabs are:
Account
Details
Listing Settings
Member
Tags
Advanced Options
Account Details
This tab is divided
into two sections:
Basic Information
and
Contact Information
.
Basic Information
This section controls core account-level settings for the selected member.
Member ID
The system displays the member's unique system-assigned ID. This field is read-only and cannot be edited.
Account Status
The following status values are available for assignment to a member account:
Label
Description
Not Active
Manually set by the administrator to deactivate an account.
Active
Member profile is visible on the front end of the site.
Cancelled
Applied when a member has cancelled the account.
On Hold
Used during manual admin approval of new signups.
Past Due
Applied when the member has an overdue subscription payment.
Incomplete
Applied when a paid signup encounters an unaccounted error; the account is created but remains unpaid.
A member profile is only live and publicly visible on the site when the status is set to
Active
.
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Status Does Not Control Billing:
Changing a member's Account Status does NOT cancel or pause any active billing subscription. Billing management must be handled separately through the subscription and payment system. A member set to "Not Active" or "Cancelled" may still be actively billed if the subscription is not independently cancelled.
Membership Plan
Displays all Membership Plans currently configured under
Finance » Membership Plans
. The administrator may reassign a member to a different plan from this field.
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Plan Change Does Not Affect Billing:
Changing the Membership Plan assigned to a member does NOT modify or cancel the member's existing subscription. Subscription management must be handled separately.
Public Listing Represents (Listing Type)
Determines how the member's public profile is displayed. Two options are available:
Individual / Person
— Profile displays the member's profile photo combined with first and last name.
Company / Organization
— Profile displays the company logo combined with the company name.
Top Level Category
Displays all Top-Level Categories configured under
My Members » Member Categories
. The administrator may reassign the member's primary category from this field.
Internal Admin Notes
A free-text field for administrator use only. Notes entered here are not visible to the member or to site visitors. This field is intended for internal record-keeping regarding the member account.
Contact Information
This section contains the member's direct contact and identity information.
First, Last, and Company Name
Information entered in these fields is displayed directly on the member's public profile. Which fields appear publicly depends on the Listing Type setting (Individual vs. Company) configured in the Basic Information section above.
Join Date
The member's recorded join date can be reviewed and edited from this field.
Phone Number and 2nd Phone Number
Primary and secondary phone numbers for the member can be added or updated here.
Email Address
The member's email address can be added or updated here.
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Email Is the Login Username:
The email address entered in this field also serves as the member's login username. Changing this value will change the credentials required for the member to log in to the site. The affected member should be notified of any email address change.
Listing Settings
This tab contains visibility, location, and lead routing settings for the selected member.
Parent ID
ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Member Manager:
The Parent ID field is only available if the
Multi-Member Manager
add-on is active on the site. Without this add-on, this setting will not appear.
When active, this field allows the administrator to assign, change, or remove a parent member ID. Assigning a parent ID converts the selected member into a sub-account under the designated parent.
To assign a parent ID, click the
Change Parent Member
button.
A dropdown search field appears, search by member ID to locate the intended parent. Select the appropriate parent member from the results.
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Eligibility Restriction:
Only Active members who share the same Membership Plan AND have the "Sub Accounts" feature enabled within their Membership Plan Settings will appear as assignable parent options. Members not meeting both criteria will not appear in the search results.
Stock Image Libraries
⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Stock Photo Library for Posts:
This option is only visible if the
Stock Photo Library for Posts
add-on is active on the site.
Homepage Featured Member Order
⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Featured Members On Homepage:
This setting is only available if the
Featured Members On Homepage
add-on is active on the site.
When active, this field allows the administrator to specify the display position of the member within the homepage streaming widget.
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Unique Position Enforcement:
The system does not permit two members to occupy the same featured position. Verify existing position assignments before making changes.
Verified Member?
This toggle controls whether the member is displayed with a verified icon badge on their public listing. Setting this to
Yes
activates the badge display.
Full reference:
How To Verify A Listing
List in All Locations?
⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Location Listing:
This setting is only available if the
Multi-Location Listing
add-on is active on the site.
When active, this toggle determines whether the member's profile is listed across all available site locations.
Max. Location Limit
⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Location Listing:
This setting is only available if the
Multi-Location Listing
add-on is active on the site.
When active, this field allows the administrator to override the maximum number of locations this specific member can list, independent of what is defined in the member's Membership Plan settings.
CC Lead Emails to
Multiple email addresses can be entered in this field. All addresses entered will receive lead notification emails alongside the member. This is intended for use cases where a member represents a company and lead emails need to be routed to additional internal recipients such as sales representatives.
Member Tags
This tab allows administrators to add or remove tags assigned to the individual member record.
Full reference:
Member Tags & Tag Groups
Advanced Options
This tab contains SEO and code injection fields that apply exclusively to the selected member's individual profile page. These settings do not affect site-wide SEO configurations.
⚠ NOTE — SEO Fields Are Optional:
All SEO metadata fields in this tab (Meta Title, Meta Keywords, Meta Description, Social Meta Title, Social Meta Description) can be left blank. The platform's existing SEO templates already supply valid metadata to search engines. These fields are intended for profile-specific overrides only.
Listing Custom HEAD Code
A custom code block that is rendered only within the
<head>
section of the selected member's profile page. This field does not affect any other pages on the site.
Listing Custom FOOTER Code
A custom code block rendered in the footer section of the selected member's profile page only.
Listing Custom CSS Code
Custom CSS entered here applies exclusively to the selected member's profile page.
⚠ NOTE:
Do not include
<style>
tags in this field. The system applies the CSS directly; wrapping tags will cause rendering issues.
Customize Listing URL
The member's profile URL slug can be edited in this field. URLs entered here should be
relative,
the full site domain is not required and should not be included.
The system also provides an option to fetch the URL from the active SEO template, which resets the slug to match the current SEO template configuration.
Fetching the URL also applies the current name-formatting rules: apostrophes are removed, most other punctuation and spaces become hyphens, and underscores are preserved. For example, Ruby’s Clay Studio becomes rubys-clay-studio in the name portion of the URL. This differs from entering a deliberate custom URL. See
How To Customize The Member Profile URL Structure
for examples and when existing URLs change.
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Dynamic URL Overwrite Risk:
If a member later changes their location or categories, the system will automatically update their profile URL, overwriting any custom URL that was previously set. To prevent this automatic override, check the lock checkbox displayed beneath the URL field after entering a custom slug.
Listing Meta Title
A custom meta title for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional; the platform's SEO templates provide baseline metadata when this field is left blank.
Listing Meta Keywords
Custom meta keywords for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional.
Listing Meta Description
A custom meta description for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional.
Listing Social Meta Title
A custom social media meta title used when the member's profile is shared on social platforms. This field is optional.
Listing Social Meta Description
A custom social meta description used when the member's profile is shared on social platforms. This field is optional.

title: My Members » Member Categories
content:
An essential part of the directory's search experience is the ability to filter results by categories. Below, we will provide an overview of this module.
For a full explanation of how categories behave on the front-end and back-end, see the
Member Categories Overview
article.
To access member categories, navigate to
My Members
>>
Member Categories
:
This section is divided into three tabs to display
Top
,
Sub
, and
Sub-Sub Categories
on the site:
Each of these tabs will have identical functionality, where categories can be searched by keyword or ID:
And can be sorted by the following options:
Keep in mind
that these sort order options will only apply to the Member Categories view in admin, it will not apply to how categories will display in the front-end.
Category Image
If needed, an image can be uploaded or removed to each category, which will be used on a streaming widget on the homepage. These images are exclusively for the homepage streaming widget and do not affect individual member profile styling.
These images are used
when the categories are set to display
on the homepage:
Displaying Top-Level and Sub-Level Categories On The Homepage
Manually Add Categories
One of the options to add categories is to do it manually via the
Add Top Level Categories
button:
More information about this process:
How To Add Categories Manually From The Admin
Member Category Actions
This dropdown includes actions like importing, exporting, and editing the code used when displaying the categories on the profile pages.
Import Categories
Another option to add member categories is via importing a CSV file:
More information about this process:
How To Import Categories Via CSV File
Export Categories
The existing member categories can be exported via the Member Category Actions dropdown:
More information about this process:
How To Export Member Categories
Edit Specialties Tab Code
And the Specialities tab of member profiles can be edited via the Edit Specialities Tab Code:
More information about this process:
How To Edit Specialities Tab Code in Member Profiles
Category Name and URL
Each of the category tabs will have the same display, with additional options to further edit them. The category name can be edited under the
Name
section:
Its live URL can be edited under the
Link URL
section:
Keep in mind
that if there are two categories with the same name, the system will assign a unique URL to one of them as can be seen in the image below:
Tip:
While the system automatically prevents URL conflicts, we recommend keeping your category names unique to ensure clean SEO patterns and a better search experience for your visitors.
Sort Order
The
Sort Order
option will determine categories' position in the Homepage streaming widget:
Displaying Top-Level Categories On The Homepage
This category sort order can also be selected for category searches and drop-downs.
Settings > General Settings > Search Settings >
Default Category Sort Order:
Lead Price by Category
If the
Lead Price By Category
add-on is active on-site, the price can be set under the
Lead Price
section:
Category Related Keywords
If the
Keywords For Categories
add-on is active on-site, related keywords can be added under the
Related Keywords
section:
Total Members per Category
Under the
Actions
column, the total number of members in each category can be seen:
If clicked on this section, the system will display the members that are in that category under the Search Members section:
Category Live Page
Under the Actions dropdown, the live page of the selected categories search results can be found:
Delete Category
The selected category can be deleted if needed. Clicking the Delete option will open a module showing an overview of the category, including any members assigned to it and any child categories it contains.
Bulk Delete Categories
All category tabs come with the option to delete categories in bulk. Select multiple categories manually or select all at once.
Note: Selecting “All” does not select every category in the system, only the categories visible on the current page. For example, if a category list spans 3 pages, using “Select All” and then deleting will only affect the categories shown on the first page, not those on subsequent pages.
Parent Category
Under the Sub and Sub-Sub Level Categories tab, an additional search filter called
Parent Category
can be found:
Reassigning Structures
Currently, admins can’t reassign the category structure directly through the system settings. To make changes, the best approach is to create a CSV file with the new structure and upload it.
Members assigned to the old categories will be unassigned after the update and will need to be recategorized. Admins can bulk-assign members to a
Top
-
Level
Category, but not to subcategories.

title: Interactions » Member Reviews
content:
Member Reviews in the Admin
The Member Reviews module allows administrators to manage reviews submitted through the website. From this section, reviews can be filtered, moderated, edited, and deleted, while also providing access to review settings and notification preferences.
Review Filters
Use the available filters to quickly locate and manage reviews.
•
Review Status
– Filter reviews by their current status.
•
Overall Rating
– Filter reviews based on star ratings.
•
Date Range
– Filter reviews by submission date.
•
Keyword
– Search reviews containing specific words or phrases.
•
Email Address
– Search by the review submitter's email address or the member who received the review.
Bulk Review Options
Multiple reviews can be selected and updated at the same time. Available statuses include:
Pending
Accepted
Declined
Waiting for Admin
Review Status Database Values
For Developers: The corresponding values below are how review statuses are saved in the database.
Pending = 0
Accepted = 2
Declined = 3
Waiting for Admin = 4
Member Review Settings
A shortcut to the Review Settings module is available from the Member Reviews page. This module includes settings related to:
General review settings
Profile page display
Search results design
Notification preferences
This button will open the review settings module, which is very similar to the Post Settings section of the admin.
An in-depth overview of this module can be reviewed at the following link:
Edit Post Settings
General Settings
Here are the general settings for the post type, allowing the admin to configure and customize the reviews.
1. Protect this Post Type?
This option will only become available if the
Members-Only Content add on
is active on the site.
2. URL Permalink
If desired, update the URL of the post type search results.
3. Make 'Email' and 'Name' Fields Readonly
When a member writes or replies to another member's review, the system automatically fills in the name, last name, company and email fields. These fields are set to “read-only” by default.
To make the fields editable, change the setting to "No"
Additional Settings
This section includes additional settings such as Display Map When Entering Location Information, Enable Results for Global Website Search and Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save
4
. Type of Post
This will display the post type.
5. Enable Results for Global Website Search
Allow the reviews to be part of the Global Website Search, Add-on is required.
6. Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save?
Set when a Webhook will be triggered when a review is submitted.
Profile Page Design
Move to this tab to set up the information regarding how the reviews will be displayed on the member public profile.
1. Profile Page Tab Title
Change the title that will be displayed on the front-end tab.
2. Profile Page Tab Order
Choose the position of the profile page tab by selecting a number from the dropdown. Each position will show the name of the selected post type. All positions with no post type assigned are available to choose from.
3. Number of Posts Displayed in Tab
Set the number of reviews to be displayed in the member's profile.
4. Profile Page Code
The header, page loop, and footer codes of the Profile Page design can be edited. However, we do not recommend changing these options unless it's handled by a developer or someone with knowledge of web development. If desired, after updating the code, it can be switched back to default. Click on this article for more information:
How to Customize the Default Post Types Code
Search Results Design
Edit and set up the search results settings for reviews in this section.
1. Search Results Page Title - H1
Edit the text for the post type title.
2. Search Results Page Sub-Title - H2
If desired, add a subtitle.
3. Search Results per Page
This controls how many total results will appear on a search results page by default.
4. Search Results Code
The option to edit the header, loop, and footer codes of the search results design is available as well.
Additional Settings
Different options will become available when clicking on the dropdown.
1. Pagination Display Options
Select how pagination is displayed on search result pages, either standard, hidden pagination, or
Insta-Load pagination
using the Add-On.
2. Order Results By
It controls the display order of items based on a database field. Please find more information on
How To Change Search Results Sorting Options
here.
3. Enable Search Results Cache
Set to YES (recommended) to cache search results and load subsequent matching search results more quickly.
Set to NO to always query the database for all searches.
Note: This cannot be enabled if "Order Results By" is set to "Random".
4. Respect Membership Plan Search Priority?
Membership Plan Search Results Priority can be set up in the
Search Visibility tab
on each plan.
5. Sidebar To Use
Name of the Sidebar that will be displayed on the search result pages, either custom or default.
6. Sidebar Search Module
Choose which search widget you would like to display in the sidebar of search results for this post type. This will only work if in the
Sidebar Manager
the sidebar has the
Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Dynamic Sidebar
Search
widget. This widget loads the search widget specified on each post type.
7. Sidebar Position on Mobile Devices
Choose to display the sidebar below (Bottom), above (Top) the results on search results pages, or hide it only on mobile devices (phones and tablets).
8. Display Google Map Option on Search Results Pages
Selecting "Yes" will display a map icon at the top of search results pages. Clicking on this icon will display the search results as pins on a Google Map.
9. Start Results View In
Choose either list view, map view, or grid view if you have the Grid View Search Results Add-On.
10. Display Expired Posts in Search Results
If YES, will display expired posts on search results pages.
Notifications
The main difference from other post type settings is the Notifications tab, where it is possible to enable or disable the following email notifications:
Admin Notifications
Notify Admin when review submitted?
When enabled it will send the admin-review-notification Email Template to the Default Website Email address when a review is submitted.
Notify the Admin that a review has been responded to?
When enabled, send out a notification to the Admin that a review has been responded to.
Member Notifications
Notify Member when they receive a review?:
Turning on this setting will send the recommendation-member Email Template to the member's email address when they receive a review. Please note this does not apply if admin needs to manually approve review.
Submitter Notifications
Notify the submitter of a review that it has been received?:
Sends the recommendation-visitor Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has been received.
Notify the submitter of a review that it has been approved?:
Sends the recommendation-accepted Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has been published.
Notify the submitter of a review that it has been responded to?:
Sends the recommendation-submitter-replied Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has received a reply from the member.
Review Module
Review ID.
Actions drop-down. (
Explained below
)
Date the review was submitted.
IP Address of the review submitter. It can be blocked if it ends up being a SPAM submission.
Quick Edit options for the member:
Actions
This section will allow the admin edit or delete the review submitted:
Edit review:
While we do not recommend editing reviews, the option is there for all directory owners to control what gets published on the website.
Delete review:
One can quickly delete any undesired review on the website.
Review Details
The last section of this module includes the details of the review:
This would include:
Status
Rating Overview
Title
Full review
Name of the review submitter
Email of the review submitter
From here the status of the review can be changed manually:
If the status is changed manually, 4 new options will show up:
Do not send email notifications
Email Member about this update
Email Reviewer about this update
Email Member and Reviewer about this update
Member Reviews on the Profiles
Members can leave reviews on profiles by clicking the “
Write a Review
” button. This feature allows users to share their experiences and feedback directly on the member’s profile. It will display within their profile and search results page.
Leaving a Review
To leave a review, visitors can visit the member's profile and click on the "Write a Review" button.
Which will open up the Reviews form:
Update Reviews URL
By default, the slug URL of the reviews is /writeareview but if the admin wishes to update this they can follow the instructions below.
To change this default URL go to:
Settings > Advanced Settings >
Default Member Review URL
The admin can provide a new slug for the reviews.
Uploading Images to a Review
If the option for
Image Upload With Reviews
is enabled in the
Membership Plan > Profile Page
:
The user will get to a second screen that allows them to upload images:
How the Reviews will Display on Member's Profile
All reviews are then shown in the "Reviews" tab and the star rating is shown above the "Write a Review" button. Reviews are displayed allowing one decimal place for review totals:
Reviews will have their designated search results page
/reviews
where visitors can check all the reviews that have been submitted to the site:
Click to View Reviews for a Specific Member
As well, visitors can click directly on the overall rating to view all the reviews for a member, this can be in the Search Results or in their profiles:
It will open a new page where it will display all the reviews for the member selected.
Time Format of the Review
The date format showing on the reviews search results page will correspond to the one selected under
Settings » General Settings » Localization
:

How To Import Members Via CSV File

>>

title: Webpage Builder: Page Details Tab & Page Options Tab
content:
Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder >> then click "
Edit
" for the existing page or click the
New Web Page
button to create a new web page:
Within the web page editor, the following options will be available in the sidebar:
Page Details Tab
This section allows users to control key attributes of a page and update its accessibility or structure.
1. Internal Nickname
This is an internal reference name for the page. It is not visible to users on the front end, but it helps with organization and searchability.
2. Page Type
Select the type of page you are creating. Learn more about page types here:
What Page Types Can I Use?
3. Protect This Page?
Enable this setting to restrict access to members only. This requires the
Members-Only
add-on.
Page Options Tab
Use this tab to customize the layout, visibility, and structure of the page using the following options.
1. Show Sidebar
Choose which sidebar to display on the page.
2. Sidebar Position
Set whether the sidebar appears on the left or right side of the page.
3. Sidebar Position on Mobile Devices
Set where the sidebar appears when the page is viewed on a phone:
Top
: the sidebar is shown above the page content.
Bottom
: the sidebar is shown below the page content. This is the default.
Hide
: the sidebar is not shown on phones.
This setting applies to screens narrower than 768 pixels. Tablets and phones turned sideways are usually wider than that, so they keep the desktop layout. Desktop screens are not affected.
4. Display Settings
Customize the page’s appearance with these options:
Full Screen Page Width
Expands the page content to fill the entire width of the browser window, removing any margins.
Hide Banner Ad Modules
Removes any banner advertisements that would normally display on the page.
Hide Header
Hides the entire header section of the website on this specific page.
Hide Footer
Prevents the footer from appearing at the bottom of the page.
Hide Top Header Menu
Removes the top navigation menu from the page.
Hide Main Menu
Hides the main navigation menu that is typically displayed at the top of the site.
Click-Enlarge Images
Allows users to click images to view a larger version in a pop-up window.
5. Advanced Options
These options provide more advanced control of the web page, such as search engine indexing and stylesheet behavior.
Apply NoIndex, NoFollow
This setting prevents the page from appearing in the sitemap and stops search engines from indexing it. If the page is set to Members Only, this option is enabled by default. More information:
Members-Only Pages
Disable Default CSS Stylesheets
Prevents the page from inheriting the default CSS styles. Learn more:
How to Override and Edit Default CSS Stylesheets
Disable Screenshot Preview
Prevents a screenshot preview of the page from appearing in the Web Page Builder.
6. Breadcrumbs
Enable breadcrumb navigation to improve user experience. Learn more here:
Common Breadcrumb Variables
.
The accepted format for custom breadcrumbs is:
Blog | /blog > Partner | https://example.com > My Page
Format rules:
>
— Separates each breadcrumb level.
|
— Assigns a URL to the breadcrumb immediately before it. Both relative URLs (such as
/blog
) and absolute URLs (such as
https://example.com
) are supported.
How it works:
The text before the
|
is the breadcrumb label that will be displayed.
The URL after the
|
is the destination for that breadcrumb.
Each
>
creates the next level in the breadcrumb trail.
The final breadcrumb can be plain text without a URL if it represents the current page.
Example:
Blog | /blog > Partner | https://example.com > My Page
This will generate the following breadcrumb trail:
Home > Blog > Partner > My Page
Where:
Blog
links to
/blog
Partner
links to
https://example.com
My Page
is the current page and is not linked.
Note:
Do not include
Home
in your custom breadcrumb string, as it is added automatically by the system.
Pre-Made Elements
Pre-built content elements are available for use in custom web pages and landing pages. They can be used to create a wide variety of custom landing pages.
More info:
Web Page Builder » Pre-Made Elements
Additional Information
Web pages can include sidebars. See:
How to Create a Sidebar

content:
Navigation Path

The
Actions
dropdown is accessible from the Search Members results table. Each member record includes an Actions menu that provides direct access to essential account management functions.
Actions Dropdown - Available Options
The Actions menu contains the following options for each member record:
Account Details
View Live Profile
Quick Edit
Login as Member
Compose Email
Payment History
Change Password
Delete Account
Clone Account
Account Details
Selecting this option displays a structured account overview for the selected member, including key profile and account-level information.
Full reference:
Account Details
View Live Profile
Selecting this option opens the member's live public-facing profile as it appears on the front end of the site. This allows administrators to verify how the profile is currently rendered for visitors.
Quick Edit
Selecting this option opens the Quick Edit module, which allows direct updates to member information without navigating away from the Search Members screen.
Full reference:
Quick Edit
Login as Member
Selecting this option allows the site administrator to access the selected member's dashboard view by logging in as that member. This is used for troubleshooting or verification of member-level permissions and visibility.
Compose Email
Selecting this option opens the Compose Email module. The selected member's email address is auto-populated in the recipient field. A message can then be drafted and sent directly from within the dashboard.
Full reference:
Compose Email
Payment History
Selecting this option opens the Payment/Transaction History view for the selected member, displaying a record of financial activity associated with that account.
Full reference:
Transactions
Change Password
Selecting this option opens the Change Password module, where a new password can be assigned to the selected member account.
Delete Account
Selecting this option initiates the member deletion workflow. A confirmation module appears before any data is removed, presenting the following configuration options that must be set prior to finalizing the deletion:
There are a few options that need to be set before a member is deleted from the site:
Delete Member
- Confirms the permanent removal of the member account.
Delete Profile Images and Files
- Determines whether all images and files attached to the member record are also removed.
Delete Member Posts
- Removes all content posts published by the member.
Re-assign Posts to another Member
- If posts are not being deleted, this option transfers them to a designated existing member.
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Irreversible Action:
Member deletion is permanent. All four configuration options in the confirmation module must be deliberately reviewed before proceeding. Failure to configure the post re-assignment option when posts are retained may result in orphaned content.
Clone Account
Selecting this option creates a duplicate of the selected member account. The following profile data is carried over to the cloned account:
Contact Details
Additional Details
Profile Photo, Logo, and Cover Photo
About Me
⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Billing Data Is Not Cloned:
Billing information is excluded from the cloning process. Each cloned member account requires
a new subscription to be created separately
in order to properly associate credit card and payment details with the new account.

title: Settings » Advanced Settings
content:
There are many Advanced Settings to configure the website for different specific tasks, and they are divided into 6 categories:
Global
URL Rules
Members
Sign Ups & Billing
Search
Text Editor
To find the advanced setting, admins can search for:
Name of the Setting
Description
System Variable
Default Value
The System Variable and Default Values for each Advanced Setting are displayed below the setting description.
1. Global
This section outlines key configuration settings and optimizations available for enhancing the website's performance, security, design, and administrative experience. These settings are categorized into four primary sections:
Optimization
Security
Design
Admin
Optimization
This section outlines key website optimization and index settings aimed at improving site performance, user experience, and search engine visibility.
Meta Robots Setting
Meta Robots Setting. (index.follow enables search engines to crawl your site. no-index, no-follow disables all robots from crawling your website.
Front-End Optimization: Only Load Google Maps when Requested by User
It improves website performance by optimizing the delivery of Google Maps JavaScript files. When enabled, the system only loads the required JavaScript files when a Google Maps feature or location autocomplete functionality is requested on a page.
This helps reduce unnecessary resource loading and can improve page load times, especially on pages where Google Maps functionality is not required.
If a widget interferes with this functionality, the system will identify  and highlight the widget causing the conflict:
Front-End Optimization: Enable Resource Delivery via CDN
Use the built-in CDN URL to speed up the delivery of resources vs. the relative path of your domain name.
Front-End Optimization: Use Content Delivery Network (CDN) for Images
Section to enter a URL to use a service like imagekit.io to serve images from an image CDN with automatic optimization and real-time transformation.
Ampify Account Id
Ampify is used to create an Accelerated Mobile Page (AMP) compliant version of your website. AMP-compliant websites are lightweight and designed to give mobile visitors a fast, smooth, and engaging experience.
Front-End Optimization: Load Latest JavaScript Files on Frontend of Website
When enabled (recommended), the frontend of the site will use updated versions of jQuery, jQuery UI, and Bootstrap JavaScript libraries.
Front-End Optimization: Mobile Preloader
If enabled, the first web page visited from a mobile device will display a brief loading message, which helps improve page speed metrics.
Front-End Optimization: Lazyload iFrame Embeds
If ON, embedded iFrames will be lazy loaded, and the full iframe will be loaded when visitors scroll to it — improving PageSpeed scores. For embedded YouTube videos, only their thumbnail will load at first, and the full video only when visitors click to play.
Front-End Optimization: Lazyload iFrame Embeds - Supported Domains
When Lazyload iframe Embeds is enabled, this comma separated list of source domains will be targeted as iFrames to lazyload.
Front-End Optimization: Convert User-Uploaded Images to WebP Format
Automatically converts all user-uploaded images to
WebP for better performance
.
Security
This section highlights important security settings designed to protect the website and its users.
Protect Login Page from Iframe
This will protect the login page from being called from an iframe that is not on the same domain name.
Enable HTTP Security Headers (CSP)
This will enable the HTTP security headers and Content Security Policies. Over an HTTP connection, the website will add headers for Content Security Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and X-XSS-Protection. Over an HTTPS connection, an additional header for Strict-Transport-Security is added.
Email Confirmation Expiration Time
Define how long new member signup confirmation links remain valid before they expire in seconds.
Design
This section covers various configuration and localization settings for the website’s front-end experience.
Default Geo-Map Image
Default top-level category image to display in geo-map.
Disable Pluralized Text
This setting will disable all pluralized text labels throughout the website. If set to OFF (default), automatic pluralization of text labels surrounded by %% will be enabled.
Google Translate Language Options
This is the list of language options displayed in the Google Translate Dropdown Menu.
Disable Drag-able Pins on Member Google Maps
The Google Maps option to 'Fill in the location fields below based on where I move the marker on the map above' when members are entering the location for their profile will be hidden.
Disable Default CSS Stylesheet
When set ON, it will disable Bootstrap and theme-styles CSS spreadsheets.
Text Direction
Will modify text if the language of the website should be read from the right side of the page to the left.
Default Center Map Location
Section to add the latitude and longitude separated by a comma.
Froala Default Width Image
The default width of images added to Froala WYSIWYG editors throughout the website.
Admin
This section controls the visibility of the built-in chatbot within the admin panel.
Show Chatbot in the Admin
When this is enabled, the BD chatbot will show up in the corner of specific pages in the admin.
Disable Screenshot Previews
Disable preview screenshots across admin sections. Select from:
Dashboard, Web Page Builder, Edit Post Settings, Form Manager and Domain Manager
.
2. URL Rules
This section outlines essential website configuration settings that govern how the site's URLs, member profile pages, dashboard, and publishing features are structured and managed. These settings are organized into the following categories:
Website
Member Profile Pages
Member Dashboard

Website
This section includes settings that control URL structure, canonical tags, page redirects, and iframe permissions for the website.
www or non-www
Select www to include www in the domain of the site, select non-www to exclude www from the domain. After changing this setting, please refresh the htaccess file to implement the change.
Default 404 Error Page
Option to select the Web Page visitors should be redirected to if the URL they requested does not exist.
Localize Canonical Tags
All member search results pages that have more than one location type in the Canonical Tag will be reduced to the most localized version possible.
Reduce Category Canonical Tags
All member search results pages that have more than one category in the Canonical Tag (a main category and a sub-level category, for example) will be reduced to only contain the most specific category.
Limit Canonical Tags to One Country
All member search results pages that have the country in the Canonical Tag will have the country removed.
Redirect to Dashboard on Checkout Pages (Logged In)
Redirect members that are logged in and visit checkout pages to the user dashboard.
Categories Page URL
URL for the Categories Page. By default this is set to '/categories' to match the Web Page for Categories.
Default Member Signup Page URL
Member signup pages use the format /checkout/membership-plan-id by default. Edit the first portion of this URL (checkout) using this setting.
Default Form File Upload URL
Files uploaded through "File Upload"; Form Fields are saved in the folder /uploads/curriculum-vitae/ by default.
Whitelist Domains Allowed to IFrame This Website
A Setting to control over which domains can load content from their website in an iframe.
Noindex Review & Connect Pages
When enabled, member review and contact pages will use a noindex, follow robots meta tag to prevent these pages from being indexed by search engines.
Noindex, Follow Paginated Search Results
When enabled, paginated search results pages, starting with page 2, will use a noindex, follow robots meta tag to prevent these pages from being indexed by search engines.
Alternate Header Logo URL
Set an alternate URL for the header logo. By default, the logo links to your website’s homepage.
Enter a full URL (e.g., https://example.com) to replace this behavior and have the logo link to a different page or external website. Leave blank to keep the default.
Member Profile Pages

Member Profile URL Structure
Elements to create a template that will be used when generating a member's profile page URL. Member_Name is required; however, you can include or exclude all other elements.
Submit Member Review Page URL
The URL used for writing a member review.
First and Last Name Order in Profile Page URL
Choose "First Name First" (default) to display member names in profile page URLs as first_name-last_name. Choose "Last Name First" to display member names in profile page URLs as last_name-first_name.

The portion of the Member Dashboard URL used for the Manage Account page.

Business Toolkit URL in the Member Dashboard.
Sub Accounts / Additional Locations Account Area URL Slug
URL slug for the Sub Accounts / Additional Locations account area page. Leave blank or set to "additional_locations" to preserve the default.

Default Member Search Page URL
The URL to use for member searches.

If this is set to 1, when members create a post in one of the member features, the location information of the member will not be included in the URL structure of the post.  If set to 0, the site will attempt to add the location information of the member to the URL structure of the post.

Portion of the URL that will display when a member is verifying their account in the Member Dashboard.
Member Dashboard URL: Leads Page
The portion of the URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is viewing their Leads page in their Account.
Member Review Details Page URL
The portion of the URL of the Member Review that will display when visiting the member reviews details page.

Member Dashboard URL: Delete Post

The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is editing a Multi-Photo Post Type.

3. Members
This section details various display, permission, security, and notification settings that help customize how member profiles function, how users interact with the platform, and how data is handled. These settings include:
Display
Permissions
Security
Display
This section includes settings that control the display and behavior of member profile images and category visibility.
Member Logo as Backup
If the member does not have a profile photo, will use the member's logo as profile photo - and vice versa.
Sub Level Category Display Limit
Sets the default number of categories displayed for members in search results.
Prioritize Profile Cover Photo as Social Share Image
The system will first attempt to use a member's profile cover photo as the social share image.
Show Only Sub-Sub Categories On Member Profiles
The system will show the sub and sub-sub level categories under ''Specialties''.
Hide Top-Level Category on Member Profile Page
The Top Level Category that displays in the header of member profile pages will be hidden.
Skip Image Size Warning for Profile Photos and Logos
Set to ON (default) to not warn members when they upload a profile photo or logo that will have to be stretched in order to work when shared on social media websites. Set to OFF to warn members when uploading a small image that will have to be stretched.
Permissions
This section covers various member management and listing features designed to enhance control, security, and user interaction.
Listing Promotion Tools
If enabled, members can use the built in promotion tools.
Disable members sending messages to themselves
If enabled and set to 1, members will not be able to send messages to themselves from their own profile pages.
Enable Member Account Billing History
Enable to allow members to view their invoices and perform all or limited actions.
Allow Live Links in Member About Me Text
Members will be allowed to include additional links in their ABOUT ME section.  This setting is only available for the Bootstrap Version of the software using the default "Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Overview Tab" widget.
Allow Live Links in the Quote Section of Profile Pages
Members will be allowed to post live links in the Quote section of their profile pages. This setting is only available for the Bootstrap Version of the software using the default 'Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Overview Tab' widget.
Strip HTML tags from Listing Details Form
If the setting is "ON", it will remove any HTML tag for the input fields in the Listing Details Form.
Prevent Reviews For Own Profile
Prevent members from submitting reviews to their own profile page.
Phone Country Codes
Phone country codes for the Country Code + Phone number form field type.
Match Sub Account Status to Parent Account
The status of Sub Accounts (Active, On Hold, Past Due, etc) will automatically update to match that of their parent account.
Security
This section addresses key security and privacy settings related to member consent, login behavior, and session management.
Require Re-Consent (GDPR)
Set this to 1 if members who have already provided consent to store their data must re-consent when taking a new action (upgrading or updating credit card info).  Set to 0 (default) if members who have already provided consent should not be shown the consent checkboxes again.
Enable Login Token Link
When set to OFF, these links will require members to log in to their account before they can view the linked page. When set to ON, members will be automatically logged in to their account when clicking on these links.
Member Login Session Active Minutes
Enter the number of minutes (without commas) a session will stay active for a member when they are logged into the website.
Enable Spam Detection For Chat Messages
When a chat message is submitted, the system will automatically check for spam and block messages that violate the rules.
Include Login Token in Member Webhook Payloads
When enabled, this setting includes the member login token in outgoing webhook payloads for member-related events, including new member registrations, member additions, updates, deletions, and member self-service form submissions. This setting is disabled by default for security purposes.
The account password hash and cookies are never included in webhook payloads, even when this setting is enabled.

Member Sign Up / Login
This section outlines various member account and registration settings that enhance user experience and site functionality.
Default First_Name Value
If a member does not have a first name defined, this value will be placed where the first name would be in email templates.
Show Inactive Countries
Displays inactive countries in drop-down menus around the website, including payment pages
Allow Multiple User Accounts with Same Email Addresses (Duplicate Email Addresses)
Members can have multiple accounts with the same email address (but they need different passwords).
Member Redirect Login Rules
Enter a comma separated list of pages (/login,/about,etc) where if a member logs in from those pages, they will always be redirected to the page defined in their membership level setting.
SPAM Protection - Member Signup Form Submission Time
The minimum number of seconds it should take to submit member signup forms once the page loads.
Reload Same Web Page After Express Member Registration
The user will remain on the same page after they sign up as a member via the Express Member Registration form instead of being redirected to the Member Dashboard.
Reload Same Web Page After Express Member Registration - Exception List
A comma-separated list of pages that will continue to redirect users to the Member Dashboard after they have signed up via the Express Member Registration form, even if the ''Reload Same Web Page After Express Member Registration'' Advanced Setting is enabled.
Use Card-Based Layout on Member Upgrade Page
When enabled, the member account Upgrade page (/account/upgrade) displays available membership plans as a modern card-based layout instead of the classic stacked list.
Member Account Status
This section manages member account statuses related to cancellations and payments.
Member Status After Requesting to Cancel
Choose which status you would like to assign to members once they have requested to cancel their account.
Suspend Past Due Member Accounts
When set to ON, members with a past due invoice will automatically have their account status changed to Past Due during the site's daily billing process, even if they do not log in. If a member logs in or appears in the Search Members page in the Admin before the daily process runs, their status will be updated to Past Due at that time instead.
Billing
This section covers advanced billing and member management features, including sales representative tracking, AVS address validation for payments, and invoice payment instructions.
Enable Sales Rep Field in Edit Members Form
Turn on this feature if you want to enable sales_rep tracking for your members.
Use AVS Billing Address Fields
When this is enabled, all forms that collect credit card information will also include fields necessary for AVS validation by your payment gateway. When you disable this, make sure all AVS settings in your active payment gateway are off.
Invoice Pay To Instructions
Enter the address and payment information that will appear in the Pay to box on your invoices to your members.
India Stripe Account Accept International Payments
Enable this setting to allow the website's Stripe account based in India to accept payments from other countries.
Save Billing Address As Member Address
Set to Yes to save the Billing Address entered during signup as the member's profile address as well.  Set to No (default) to only save the Billing Address as billing information and not as their profile address.
MEMBER CREDITS: Enable Credit System
Turn this setting ON to enable the credit system. Turn this setting OFF to disable showing the credit system functionality and auto-applying of credits to your members. You must also have the Member Credit System Add-on active for this setting to work.
MEMBER CREDITS: Enable Prorated Plan Changes
Only works when the “Member Credits System” Add-On is enabled and the "Enable Credits System" Advanced Setting is set to "ON". Set to ON in order to enable prorated calculation when members change their own plans.
MEMBER CREDITS: Proration: Deduct First Day Usage from Proration Calculation
Only works with “MEMBER CREDITS SYSTEM” add-on.. Set to ON to deduct the first day's usage from the proration amount calculation.
MEMBER CREDITS: Select Transaction Types Credits Can Be Applied To
Select the types of transactions where member credits can be applied. If an item is unchecked, member credits will not be used for those types of transactions.
Notifications
This section focuses on email notification settings related to member billing and account status changes.
Send Email Notification When Member Updates Billing Details
When a member updates their credit card or billing information in the new billing module, send a notification to the email addresses specified here.
Do Not Receive Email After Cancellation
When set to OFF (default), the Default Website Email Address will receive an email notification when a member requests to cancel their accounts.  When set to ON, no notification email will be sent when a member requests to cancel their account.
Send Failed Payment Notification Emails
Set this to ON to send an email notification to the Default Website Email address when a user's attempt to sign up for a paid Membership Plan fails.
Do Not Send Empty Daily Reminder Report
When this is set to ON, the system will not send a Daily Invoice Report to the admin when there is no billing activity.

Display

Display
This section focuses on enhancing location-based search and URL functionality.
Countries to Display Cities Instead of States
Enter a comma-separated list of Country Codes that should link to a list of cities in the country instead of states/provinces on the /locations page of the site.
Show Member Position in Member Search Results
If turned on the member's position will show on member search result pages.
Enable All Location Features for "Pretty URL" Search Results Pages (Additional Google Maps API Cost)
Set to OFF (default) to show members that match a ''Pretty URL'' search results page's location by text only (do fewer Google Maps API calls). Set to ON to include all member location search results features (do more Google Maps API calls).
All Location Features For Pretty URL Search Results Pages API Key
Enter the Google Maps API Key for the 'Enable All Location Features For ''Pretty URL'' Search Results Pages' functionality.
Prompt visitors to share their location automatically on page load?
When set to OFF (default), visitors to the site can share their location by clicking on the icon in the website's location search fields.  When set to ON, prompt all visitors to share their location automatically as soon as they visit the website.
Insta-Load Search Results Button Behavior
Select how more search results are fetched with the ''Load More Results'' button.
Search Modules
This section offers settings to customize how categories and filters behave in member search results.
Auto-Expand Sub-Level
If enabled, auto-expands the next drop-down menu in a chained search series.
Recommend Sub-Level
If enabled, the next drop-down in a chained search series will be optional rather than pre-selecting the first option.
Show Sub-Categories in Member Search Results
Will display member's sub-level categories on member search result pages. NOTE - will slow down load time.
Dynamic Category Search Accordions Open
It will load all the accordions on the dynamic category sidebar modules open.
Show Top Category in Member Search Results
If turned on the member's top level category will show on member search result pages.
Dynamic Category Filter - Broad Match
Set to ON (default) to return members listed in ANY of the selected categories. Set to OFF to only return members listed in ALL of the selected categories.
Dynamic Category Filtering - Only Show Categories Related to the Searched Category
When clicking on dynamic filters checkboxes, keep the top or sub category context from the URL so the dynamic filters in sidebar only show categories related to the page the category filter widget is being displayed on.
Search Logic
This section defines how location-based searches are conducted for different administrative levels, such as neighborhoods, counties, and states, allowing results to be returned based on either geographical bounds or a specified radius.
Neighborhood Search Method
Select how results will be returned when a user searches for a "Neighborhood" location (typically a section of a city in many countries). Selecting "Bounds" will return results that are within the bounds of the searched location.  Selecting ''Radius'' (default) will will return results within the ''Default Search Radius'' of the center of the searched location.
Administrative Area Level 2 Search Method
This setting needs the ''Members Search Engine'' setting to be set to 1 to work. With this setting, you can choose the type of search that will be performed when a location is an Administrative Area Level 2 or has the same location scope as an Administrative Area Level 2. The two options that it has are ''bounds'' (default) or ''radius''. if set to radius, the radius that will be applied will be the one on the setting ''Default Radius Search".
Administrative Area Level 2 Search Method
Select how results will be returned when a user searches for an ''Administrative Area Level 2'' location (typically a ''county'' in many countries). Selecting ''Bounds'' (default) will return results that are within the bounds of the searched location.  Selecting ''Radius'' will will return results within the ''Default Search Radius'' of the center of the searched location.
Administrative Area Level 1 Search Method
Select how results will be returned when a user searches for an ''Administrative Area Level 1'' location (typically a state or province). Selecting ''Bounds'' (default) will return results that are within the bounds of the searched location.  Selecting ''Radius'' will will return results within the ''Default Search Radius'' of the center of the searched location.
Member Keyword Search - Exclude Custom Fields
Enter a comma-separated list of the custom field variable names to exclude when performing a keyword search.
Member Keyword Search - Exclude Custom Fields
Enter a comma-separated list of the custom member fields to exclude when performing a keyword search.
Member Keyword Search - Exclude Default Fields
Enter a comma-separated list of the default member fields to exclude when performing a keyword search.
Complete Profile Fields
A comma-separated list [NO SPACES] of the Member Profile Fields that must be filled in by a member for their profile to be considered "COMPLETE". If the "Require Complete Profiles" setting is enabled, a member will not appear in search results unless their profile is "COMPLETE".

title: Developer Hub » HTACCESS File
content:
An .htaccess (hypertext access) file is a directory-level configuration file supported by several web servers, used for configuration of site-access issues, such as URL redirection, URL shortening, access security control (for different web pages and files), and more.
Because of the sensitivity of this file, edits should only be made by someone familiar with server-side configuration.
Incorrect changes can cause the website to stop loading
.
Before Editing the HTACCESS File
The .htaccess file is powerful but easy to break. Even a small typo
can make the entire website inaccessible
. For that reason:
Always save a copy of the current .htaccess content before making any changes.
Only make changes when absolutely necessary.
If unsure about a directive or configuration rule, please consult a qualified developer.
Accessing the HTACCESS File
Go to
Developer Hub
Click on "
HTACCESS File"
From this screen, the current file contents can be viewed and edited if needed.
Restoring the Default File
If issues arise or a reset is required, the Restore Default button can be used to revert the file to its original version.
Before restoring, it is strongly recommended to copy and save the current content into a .txt file for reference.
.htaccess file
code area.
"Save Changes"
button.
"Restore Default"
.htaccess file button.
When This Tool Should Be Used
Most website owners will not need to edit the .htaccess file. Edits should be considered only when:
A server-level configuration change is specifically required.
The impact of the modification is fully understood.
A backup of the current file has been created.

title: 08/03/18 - Software Updates
content:
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
Updates:
Now the Top, Sub and Sub-sub Category dropdowns in the lead match form will be sorted alphabetically by default.
Widget Involved:
Bootstrap - Contact Member Category Dropdowns
We fixed the issue which was preventing the display of values selected in custom Checkbox Fields added to forms.
We deprecated the "Match Leads" link of the Actions box in the Search Members page on the Admin Area, as this was part of the legacy Lead system.
We added the ability for an Admin to designate the URL they want the claim listing link on profile pages to link to on a per-Product basis.  This allows a site to have multiple different Claim Listing Products for different types of users that require different product description pages.  In order to use this new feature navigate to
Admin
>>
Finance
>>
Products
>>
Edit
>>
Pricing Tab.
This new feature require the purchased of the
Claimable Business Listings
Add-On.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal functionality of the
Sub Sub Sidebar Search
widgets.
Widgets Involved:
Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Sub + Sub-Sub
Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Sub_Sub_Sub_Location
We fixed the issue which was causing Static Pages to load widgets on the page 3 times in some cases.
Now when an Admin logs in to a Member's account from the Admin Area, the system will redirect the Members to the
/account/home
instead of
/account/account/home.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the Invoice Tax customization applied to some sites when a Member purchases a lead.
Widget Involved:
Bootstrap Theme - Account - Leads Details Page - Purchase Button
Radio Button Fields in the Admin will now be displayed side by side
instead of stacked one on top of the other.
We fixed an issue which was causing the price of a lead to change during purchase for some currencies.
The
Downloadable PDF Invoices
Add-On has been released.
We added URL validation in order to prevent duplicate URLs from being created across different types of features of a site.  Now the following sections of the Admin cannot save a URL for one feature when it has already been saved for another: Add/Edit Web Pages, Post Settings, Member Categories.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the
Detect Visitor Location
Add-On causing the Location Fields to be erroneously filled as Antarctica in some cases.
Widget Involved:
Bootstrap Theme - Function - Google Location Suggest
We fixed an issue that was causing members who request to delete their account from the Member Dashboard to be shown a blank screen after making the request.
Widgets Involved:
Bootstrap Theme - Account - Delete Account
Bootstrap Theme - Function - API
We fixed an issue which was preventing the End Subscription button on the Member Details Page in the Admin Area from functioning properly in some cases.
The Member Categories page in the Admin Area has been fully refactored and the UI has been updated.  We improved the search and filter capabilities as well no longer requiring a page refresh when saving changes.
The Website Currency Setting and the Feature Currency Setting have now been unified into a single Website Currency setting on the Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration tab.
