title: Using CSS to target elements based on User Sessions (Logged In Members vs Visitors)
content:
Previously to show/hide elements when a user is logged in or out, users had to use complicated PHP in specific areas of code.
Now we've made it easier to control by including two classes to the <body> element that will be used depending on the user's logged-in status:
Logged Out
: <body class="
general-session
">
Logged In
: <body class="
user-session session-plan-level-
ID
#
">
With these classes it will be easier to hide simple elements like menu items, buttons, links, images using CSS in the Design Settings rather than having to go into specific sections of the code and use PHP every time.
Example Using the CSS Method
The mini nav menu is showing when user's are logged in and out:
This menu has 2 custom buttons:
"
Logged In Button
" - show when logged in and hide when logged out
"
Logged Out Button
" - show when logged out, hide when logged in
I want to hide the "Logged In Button" when a user is logged out, so I added a class called "hide-logged-out":
Similarly, I added the class "hide-logged-in" to the "Logged Out Button":
Finally, I added some CSS to the site to apply "display:none;" in the different situations:
body.user-session .hide-logged-in, body.general-session .hide-logged-out {
    display: none;
}
This will apply "display:none;" to any element with the "hide-logged-in" class when the <body> has the class "user-session" (when a user is logged in).
It will also apply "display:none;" to any element with the "hide-logged-out" class when the <body> has the class "general-session" (when a user is logged out).
Before applying the CSS, both buttons display:
After applying the CSS, I only see the "Logged In Button" when logged in:
And only see the "Logged Out Button" when logged out:

title: Generating a CSR for an SSL certificate in cPanel
content:
Generate a Certificate Signing Request (CSR)
A Certificate Signing Request (CSR) is required when purchasing an SSL certificate from a third-party provider. The CSR contains information about the domain and organization requesting the certificate and is used by the SSL provider during the certificate issuance process.
Access the cPanel Dashboard
Log in to the website's Admin Area and navigate to
Developer Hub > cPanel Dashboard
.
Open the SSL/TLS Manager
Within cPanel, locate the
SSL/TLS
option in the Security section.
Create the CSR
Click
Generate, View, or Delete SSL Certificate Signing Requests
.
Complete the CSR Information
Complete the required fields, including the domain name, organization details, and location information.
The
Domains
field should include all domains and subdomains that will be secured by the SSL certificate.
For a wildcard SSL certificate, the domain can be entered as:
*.example.com
Alternatively, individual domains and subdomains can be specified separately:
www.example.com
example.com
mail.example.com
Generate the CSR
After all required information has been entered, click
Generate
to create the Certificate Signing Request.
Save the CSR and Private Key
Both the CSR and private key should be saved in a secure location. The CSR will be required when purchasing the SSL certificate, while the private key will be required when installing the certificate on the server.
Loss of the private key may prevent the SSL certificate from being installed successfully and could require generating a new CSR.

title: How to Use Zapier Triggers with the API
content:
It is now possible to get database information exported through the API using
Zapier Triggers
. Zapier triggers work by checking the database for new information periodically, approximately every 15 minutes.
There are currently 10 options:
Get APIs
New APIs
Get New Lead by Field
Get New Post by Field
Get New User by Field
Get Form Inquiries by Field
Get Review by Field
New All Users
New All Leads
New All Posts
New All Reviews
New All Form Inquiries
Note:
For the "New All" triggers, it is not required to send a field as a parameter, this will retrieve all new records that have been added.
For this example, we will be setting up a Get New User by Field trigger and connecting it to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
Checklist Before Moving Forward With This Example
Make sure to generate a unique API Key using the documentation down below as a guideline. Please make sure to save the API Key in a safe place as it is not accessible after it has been created:

title: Google Maps Issues: Index
content:
There are 3 errors that can cause momentary interruptions to the Google Maps integration:
Missing an API
Missing HTTP Referrers
Billing Errors
These errors can be identified using the browsers INSPECT TOOL:
The Google Maps Error Alert in the Admin
When Google refuses the Google Maps key, a red
Google Maps Error
button appears at the top of every admin page. The
Google Maps API Status
card on the dashboard (under
My Website Resources
) shows the same result. The card has two rows, because the site uses two separate keys:
Website key
: used for maps and location search on the website. This key is tested in the browser.
Server key
: used for member geocoding and imports. This key is tested from the server.
Each row shows its own result, such as
Billing problem on your Google project
,
Google does not recognise this key
,
Maps JavaScript API is not enabled
, or
Google Maps key is working
. Clicking a row, or the red
Google Maps Error
button, opens a details window that explains what Google reported and lists numbered fix steps.
Red, Amber and Green Results
The website key is tested from the admin first. When Google refuses the key only because the admin address is not in the key's website restrictions (normal for a key restricted to the website's own domain), the same test runs again on the website's live domain, exactly the way visitors use the key. That answer replaces the admin result, so a restricted key now shows a definite green or red result instead of amber.
Red
: Google reported a real problem with the key, such as billing turned off, a key Google does not recognise, a required API that is not enabled, or
Google refuses your key on your website
when the live domain is missing from the key's website restrictions. The details window names Google's reason and lists the fix steps. Only red results raise the
Google Maps Error
button.
Amber
(
Maps blocked on this admin page
): Google refused the key on the admin address and the live-domain test got no answer, because the domain is not connected to the site yet, does not resolve, or did not answer within about 20 seconds. This is not treated as an error and raises no alert. Check the website's own maps and location search directly, or test again once the domain is connected.
Green
: Google accepted the key.
Google Maps key is working
means it was accepted on the admin address;
Maps work on your website
means it was accepted on the live domain (the admin address is refused, which only affects maps inside the admin).
The dashboard card shows the admin result first and switches to the live-domain result as soon as it arrives.
Testing the Keys on the Integrations Tab
Both keys can also be tested where they are entered:
Settings
>
General Settings
>
Integrations
, below the
Google Maps Javascript API Key
field.
Website key
: tested when the tab opens, again shortly after typing stops in the key field, and again after
Save Changes
. A key that has only been typed is tested from the admin; if Google refuses it only on the admin address, the row reads
Blocked on this admin page - save to test it on your website
. Once saved, the key is also tested on the live domain as described above. A value that is not shaped like a Google key is flagged without asking Google (keys start with
AIza
and are 39 characters long).
Server key
: tested from Brilliant Directories servers; the key itself is never sent to the browser. When no server key is saved, the row shows a grey
No server key saved
. A server key is only needed to geocode members during an import and for service-area search pages.
Edit both keys - Save & test
: opens the same key editor as the details window. Each
Test
link re-runs that row's test.
Clicking a result opens the details window with Google's reason, the fix steps and the key editor. A key Google refuses in the editor is not saved.
What the Details Window Offers
Google Cloud Console
: opens the Google Cloud Credentials page in a new tab.
Test key
: tests the website key with Google right now. When Google accepts the key, the
Google Maps Error
button clears immediately. The server key row has no
Test key
button; that key is re-checked when an admin page loads.
Your Google Maps Settings
: the website key, the server key and the
Use Places API (New)
switch can be edited right in the window. Click
Save & test
and each key is tested with Google first. A key Google refuses is not saved. Leaving the server key empty keeps the saved server key. The switch is the same setting as
Enable New Google Maps Places API
in Advanced Settings.
Places API (New) switch.
The
Use Places API (New)
switch can only be turned on when the key works with Places API (New). If the switch will not turn on, the key most likely does not have Places API (New) enabled in Google Cloud. Enable it as described in
Google Maps: Add APIs
, wait a few minutes, and try again.
How the Alert Clears
After a fix, the alert clears itself. Admin pages re-check the keys about every 10 minutes and the
Google Maps Error
button fades once Google accepts the key.
Test key
or
Save & test
clears it immediately. A remembered error lasts at most 7 days. Placeholder sites on a
directoryup.com
address never show the alert, because the keys are checked only on live domains.
Missing an API
STEPS TO FIX:
Google Maps Issues: Missing an API
Missing HTTP Referrers
STEPS TO FIX:
Google Maps Issues: Editing HTTP Referrers
Billing Errors
STEPS TO FIX:
Google Maps Issues: Billing Errors
****
Google requires that all Maps API Keys have a credit card on file for any charges that the API usage may incur. That is due to a change in their policy, beginning on June 11, 2018, Google requires all users to add billing information to their account in order to activate Google Maps API keys.
However, Google gives all users enough free credits each month so that the vast majority of websites will never have to pay anything for this service.
In fact, with this update Google is actually giving users even more free credit than before.  The only difference is that they now ask for billing information during the setup process rather than after a user consumes all of their free credits.

title: Changelog - December 2023
content:
New Features:
We created a new Design Setting for the "Featured Blog Article Slider" widget called "Hide on Mobile?". When this setting is active, the system will hide the corresponding widget module on the homepage when viewed from a mobile device. To use this new feature navigate to the
Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage tab >> Select Content to Display.
We added a new Design Setting called "Photo Quality". This setting adds the ability to select the quality of the images used in homepage widgets. To use this new setting, navigate to the
Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage tab >> Select Content to Display.
We
added the ability to auto-fetch member images and auto-geocode the member when importing members via CSV file or when using the Brilliant Directories API.
We added a new "Reviews" endpoint to the Brilliant Directories API.  Using this API endpoint, Admins can create, update, delete, match, and read Member Reviews.
Enhancements / Fixes:
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Print" button on Multi-Photo Post Type detail pages from displaying the images properly in the print layout in some cases.

We fixed an issue which was affecting the abilty to pass a coupon code as part of the checkout URL using the "refcode" URL variable in some cases.
We updated the Froala WYSIWYGs on the frontend of sites to add the "Replace" image feature when updating images inside the content editor.
We updated the Private Member Chat Add-On to automatically scroll to the most recent messages at the bottom of the chat when viewing messages in the Member Dashboard.

We fixed an issue which was causing the system to add default Brilliant Directories CSS classes to elements inside <iframe> elements in some cases.

updated the "Member Profile URL Structure" Advanced Setting in order to include the Country Short Name (country_short_name) and State Short Name (state_short_name) as options to use with the setting.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to change some of the text inside the Profile Photo tab in the Member Dashboard when the site has activated a Member Dashboard Webhook in some cases.
We implemented an update in order to respect the Default Website Language setting when sending emails from the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from collecting past due invoices using member credits from the Admin area in some cases.

We fixed an issue which was preventing the "List View" and "Box View" buttons in the Media Manager from working properly in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the display of special characters in a post's title when using the "RSS Feed for Posts" Add-On.
We added the "aria-label" attribute to all default <select> dropdown fields on the frontend of sites. This attribute is required for accessibility purposes and will increase scores in 3rd party tools like Google PageSpeed and GTMetrix.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Hero Title Text Font Size" Design Setting from being applied as expected in some cases.
We added support for Youtube Short, Youtube Live, TikTok, and DailyMotion videos when creating a video post from the Member Dashboard.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the "Post Search Results Placeholder" image on Post Search Results pages in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to login as a member during the process of purchasing a Digital Product posted to the site in some cases.
We f
ixed an issue which was preventing the system from exporting members using the Export Member Data Add-On in some cases.

on Post Details pages
for Video posts in some cases.

meta
description" tag on member profile pages in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Refresh Live Website" functionality from working properly after saving widgets in some cases.
We fixed an issue with the "Member Credits System" Add-On that was causing the system to grant a member credits when upgrading, even when an error occurred during the upgrade process in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to complete the paid signup process after applying a coupon code discount in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to use the "Remove File" button related to a File Upload Field in a form in some cases.
We added the ability for members to use the Stock Photo Library Add-On when adding and image to a post from the Member Dashboard
for Single Image Post Types.

updated the Related Searches widget in order to include related searches related to the member's
top level category
as long as the member has a top level category selected.
We fixed an issue with the Reviews Homepage Streaming widget which was preventing the "Include Posts from Non-Searchable Member" streaming widget setting from working properly in some cases.
We fixed an issue with the Bookmark my Favorites Add-On which was preventing the bookmark counter from working properly on the Sub-Account tab in member profile pages in some cases.
The
"Membership Plan Name" and "Membership Plan ID" variables have now been added to the Email Variable list shown when editing an Email Template.
W
e updated the Export Member Data Add-On in order to include the "Product Name" of an invoice when exporting invoices from the Transaction History page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from respecting the "Hide Reviews Star Rating Options" Membership Plan Setting when the "Member Profile - Write a Review" SEO Template has been customized on a site.

updated the Froala WYSIWYG to the latest version available.
We fixed an issue with the Member Post Import logic which was causing the system to add duplicate posts during import after checking the 'Auto Import the posts image base on "Post Image" during import' Setting in some cases.
We updated the Member Transaction History section in the Member Dashboard in order to add support for pagination and sorting the columns.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Filter by Form" field from working properly when searching on the Form Inquiries page in the Admin.
We updated the "Post - Standard" and "Post - Photo Album" webhooks to include the first_name, last_name, email, company, full_name and filename fields as part of the data sent to the webhook endpoint.
W
e fixed an issue which was causing Member Profile Photos uploaded through the Member Dashboard to distort the images during the upload process on some Apple devices.
We added the support for using the variable name of custom fields found in the Member Leads form as variables in the "3rd Party Email Addresses" fields in the Lead Settings.
W
e fixed an issue which was preventing Member Searches from returning accurate location results when the "Localized Search" Advanced Setting was enabled on a site in some cases.
We updated the robots meta tag to "no index, no follow" when loading the Pretty URL version of a member search results page which does not have any results and the "Google Search Assist" Add-On is enabled on the site.
In all,
over 80 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.

title: How Can I Create a New Text Label or Custom Text Labels
content:
Brilliant Directories does not currently include a feature for creating custom text labels. However, the same result can be achieved by creating a custom widget that contains the desired text and displaying it anywhere on the website using a widget shortcode.
Creating a Text Label Widget
Log in to the Admin Area.
Navigate to
Toolbox → Widget Manager
.
Click
New Widget
.
In the
HTML
tab, enter the text that should be displayed.
Assign the widget a descriptive nickname that makes it easy to identify later.
For example, if the widget displays the text
"Join Us"
, a nickname such as
Text - Join Us
helps keep similar text label widgets organized.
Save the widget after entering the desired content.
Displaying the Text Label
Once the widget has been created, it can be displayed anywhere that supports widget shortcodes.
For example:
Copy
[widget=Text - Join Us]
Wherever this shortcode is added, the widget's content will be rendered on the page. This approach makes it easy to reuse the same text in multiple locations while only needing to update it in one place.

title: How to Apply Coupon Codes or Price Overrides in the Admin When Manually Creating an Order
content:
When manually creating an order in the Admin Area, there is no need to apply a coupon code. Instead, the order price can be adjusted directly, allowing any discount or price override to be entered manually.
Creating a Manual Order with a Custom Price
Log in to the Admin Area.
Navigate to
My Members → Search Members
.
Locate the member and click
Actions → Payment History
.
Click
New Order
in the upper-right corner.
Select the appropriate
Membership Plan
and
Billing Cycle
.
Enter the desired price for the order. This value overrides the default price for the selected membership plan, making a coupon code unnecessary.
Complete the remaining order details as needed.
Click
Save Changes
to create the order.
This approach can be used whenever a discounted price or one-time price adjustment needs to be applied to a manually created order.

content:
A QR code can be displayed in the Member Dashboard by enabling the appropriate setting in the Membership Plan.

Navigate to
Finance → Membership Plans
.
Edit the Membership Plan where the QR code should be displayed.
Open the
Member's Dashboard
tab.
Locate the
Show QR Code Module
setting. The keyword filter can be used to find it quickly.
Set the option to
Yes
.
Click
Save Changes
.

title: How to Clear and Remove User Cookies on Specific Web Pages
content:
This article explains how to remove a specific cookie when a visitor accesses a particular page on the website.
Warning
Cookies are used to maintain important website functionality, such as user authentication and session data. Removing cookies may affect how certain features behave. Use this code only when the cookie is no longer needed.
For example, the
claim_listing
cookie is created when a visitor begins the process of claiming a member listing.
If the goal is to prevent the visitor from continuing the claim process after navigating to another page, the following code can be added to a landing page or widget to remove the
claim_listing
cookie.
Copy
<?php
setcookieSameSite
(
"claim_listing"
,
""
, time
-
36000
,
"/"
,
$_SERVER
[
'HTTP_HOST'
],
true
,
true
,
"Lax"
);
?>
Once this code is executed, the
claim_listing
cookie is cleared from the visitor's browser, preventing the claim process from continuing on subsequent pages.

title: Block Traffic by Country
content:
Say goodbye to unwanted website traffic and hello to a more secure and personalized website with the Block Traffic by Country website add-on.
Easily prevent visitors from specific countries from accessing the front-end of your website, enhancing security and tailoring the website experience to the target audience. Ensure that only the desired audience can access the website.
This add-on identifies a visitor's country based on their IP address. And based on the geo-location of the IP address , the rules set with the add-on will control a visitor's ability to access the website.
Key Features & Benefits
:
Allow traffic from all countries except specified countries
Allow traffic only from specific countries
Website visitor location determined by their IP address
Enhance security by preventing traffic from countries known for malicious activity
Reduce spam by blocking traffic from countries notorious for spamming
Tailor content based on the geographic location of your visitors
More easily comply with regional regulations by restricting access to specific countries
How To Get This Add-On
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available:
Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually:
Block Website Traffic By Country Add-On
Using the Add-On
Go to:
General Settings > Localization >
Block Traffic by Country
This will allow website owners to block unwanted traffic from entire countries.
There are 3 options:
Disable Setting
Only Allow Traffic From
Block Traffic From
Disable Setting
This will deactivate the setting from allowing or blocking specific countries. Sign ups from all countries are allowed.
Only Allow Traffic From
This will set the countries that
are
allowed to sign up on the website. If the country is not in the list, users in those countries will
not
be allowed to sign up on the website.
Block Traffic From
This will decide the countries that are
not
allowed to sign up on the website. If the country is not on the list, users in those countries
can
sign up on the website..
Adding Countries
Click on the white space and a
Country List
will appear:
Scroll or type in the country:
Select the country to add it to the list:
Removing Countries
Use the "
X
" to remove a country from the list:
Blocked Countries
When a country is blocked from the website, there is a
403 Forbidden
warning:
API Requests Are Not Blocked
Requests to the website's API (addresses that begin with
/api/v2/
) are not blocked by this add-on. Integrations such as BD Butler, Zapier and n8n keep working even when their requests come from a country that is blocked, or from a country that is not on the "Only Allow Traffic From" list. API requests still need a valid API key. All other pages are still blocked or allowed by the country rules.
Websites that already use this add-on.
The API exemption is added to the website's
.htaccess
file when the country rules are regenerated. That happens when the
Block Traffic by Country
settings are changed and saved, not when the tab is saved without a change, and not when the website cache is refreshed. To add the exemption to an existing website, go to
Settings >> General Settings >> Localization
, add a country to the list (or remove one), click
Save Changes
, then put the list back the way it was and click
Save Changes
again. Websites that set up the add-on after this change receive the exemption automatically.
Important Notes
Even if your website only serves a single country or market, sometimes your members and visitors are accessing your website while traveling or from other locations. Be cautious when deciding to block countries.
If you're working with staff or team members abroad, make sure you're not blocking their access to your website.
Sometimes search engines like Google, Bing and other tools need to crawl your website from IP addresses and countries that you may have blocked. So use the tool as needed and with intent.
Remember, you can always block and unblock countries temporarily based on your needs.
The most practical use of this add-on is to block traffic from countries that are delivering spam to your website. When the spam stops, you may choose to unblock and allow the country again.

title: What is a Backlink?
content:
A backlink is like a virtual high-five from one website to another. It's a link that points from another website back to yours. Think of it as a vote of confidence in the online world.
When a website links to your site, it's telling search engines, "Hey, this content is valuable and worth checking out!" This is crucial because search engines like Google use these links to determine how important and relevant your website is. The more high-quality backlinks you have, the higher your site can rank in search results, which means more people can find and visit your site.
But not all backlinks are created equal. It's all about quality over quantity. A backlink from a well-respected, authoritative site is like gold dust, while a link from a low-quality site might not do you much good.
So, how do you get these awesome backlinks? Here are a few strategies:
Create Stellar Content
: If your content is amazing, informative, and helpful, other websites will naturally want to link to it.
Guest Blogging
: Write articles for other websites in your industry, and include a link back to your site.
Broken Link Building
: Find broken links on other websites, and suggest your content as a replacement.
Reach Out
: Don't be shy! Contact other website owners and ask if they'd be interested in linking to your content.

title: Settings » Domain Manager » Usage and Storage Cleanup
content:
The
Usage
tab in
Settings > Domain Manager
shows how much of the website's plan is in use and provides a storage breakdown and cleanup tools.
Before starting
The administrator must have permission to view website resources. Download any export or backup files that must be retained before running cleanup.
Review plan usage
Open
Settings > Domain Manager > Usage
.
Review
How much of your plan you are using
.
Click
Refresh
to update the displayed figures.
The card includes members, the current month's bandwidth, and storage. A sent-email allowance appears where applicable; it can be daily or monthly depending on the site's email arrangement. Private-server administrators may also see
Server usage
. Use
Increase Limit
beside an allowance to review options for more capacity.
The Usage tab compares current consumption with the website’s plan limits.
Measure storage
Find
What is using your storage
.
Click
Measure
.
Review the returned breakdown before choosing a cleanup action.
Storage measurement helps distinguish files, mail, and database use. A mailbox consuming space needs a different response from old export files.
Measure storage before choosing a cleanup action. The displayed figures are an example from an internal test website. The folder breakdown depends on the server; where it is unavailable, the panel says Folder detail is not available on this server and still reports the database and email totals.
Use the cleanup tools
Action
What it removes
Delete unused images
Image files no longer referenced by members, posts, or listings.
Delete old export files
Saved CSV and spreadsheet export files. Download any files still needed first.
Delete backup files
Backup archives stored in the website account. Server-level backups are separate.
Cleanup permanently removes files.
The Domain Manager cannot undo these deletions. Read the selected action’s scope and retain any necessary files before confirming.
Select the cleanup action that matches the measured storage use.
Review its confirmation message.
Confirm only the intended deletion.
Wait for the action to finish.
Review the refreshed storage measurement.
These cleanup controls are intended for the named file categories, rather than deleting member records, web pages, or database content. For high bandwidth use, see
How to Optimize the Bandwidth Usage of a Site
. For mailbox storage, use
Mailboxes
.

title: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Members
content:
Streaming Members
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Members section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the Newest Members that sign up to the website.
Visual Guide of the Streaming Members Settings
1. Streaming Members Title
This setting controls the title for this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs.
2. Title Color
This setting controls the title color for the title of this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs.  Click on the color bar to display the color pallet and select the color accordingly.
3. Display Options
This setting control the total amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results.
4. Results Per Row
This setting control the amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section per row. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results.
5. Enable Carousel Slider?
This setting control the layout of the Streaming Members section, if enabled the Streaming section will display as a carousel, with arrows at each side, instead of displaying the Streaming Members in a grid layout, they will appear in the carousel. If set to No, the Streaming Members will be displayed in the default grid view.
6. Hide On Mobile?
This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Members section will display on mobile devices. If enabled this section will not appear on mobile devices. If the setting is set to No, the Streaming Members section will appear on mobile devices accessing the website.
7. Only Show Members with Photo
This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Members section will display members that have already uploaded either a Member Image or Member Logo, but the system will only display the Member Image, not the Member Logo. The options are: "Show All, Even if Member Does Not Have Photo" or "Member Must Have Photo"
8. Show "View All" Button
This setting controls whether or not the View All button on Streaming Members section will display in this section. If set to Yes, the button will show up at the top right corner of the section, if set to No, the button will not be displayed. To learn more about how to edit the color of this button, navigate to the following link:
Design Settings » Button Colors
9. Sort Order
This setting controls the order in which the Streaming Members will be displayed on the homepage of the website. The options are:
Newest: this will set the newest members first.
Oldest: this will set the oldest members first.
Random: this will set a random order based on the browser session.
10. Only Display 'Verified' Members?
This setting will show only members that have verified their account with this process:
How to Verify a Listing
.
11. Display Verified Badge?
This setting controls will display the verified badge.
12. Limit Members Shown to These Membership Plans
This setting controls the membership plan that will be used to display members from. If left blank all members from all membership plans will be displayed on this section.
13. Display Additional Information
This setting controls the information displayed per member in the Streaming Members section on the homepage of the website. The options to choose from are:
Display About Snippet
Display Top Level Category
Display Sub Level Category
Display Short Description
Do Not Display Additional Information
Display About Snippet
Using this option will display the About Snippet field from the Contact Details form.
Display Top Level Category
Using this option will display the Top Level Category from the Contact Details form.
Display Sub Level Category
Using this option will display the Sub Level Category from the Additional Details form.
Display Short Description
Using this option will display the Short Description from the Contact Details form.
Do Not Display Additional Information
Using this option will hide this section.
14. Display Location
This setting controls whether or not the address or location for the members is displayed on this section of the homepage. If set to Yes the location or address will be displayed, if set to No, the address or location will be hidden for the members on the Streaming Members section of the homepage.
15. Display Star Ratings
This setting enables or disables the display of star ratings for streaming members. Administrators can choose to show or hide star ratings.
16. Only Display Members Who Have Star Ratings
This setting specifies whether only members with star ratings should be displayed. It includes options to require a minimum star rating from 1 to 5 stars.
17. Display View Profile Button
This setting controls whether or not the button that links website visitors to the members profile will be displayed. If set to Yes the button will appear in the Streaming Members widget of the homepage. If set to No, the button will not be displayed.

title: Import Members: "active" Variable
content:
In an import file for Brilliant Directories, the variable "
active
" decides the
Active
status of members. This controls whether the profile will not be visible on the front-end of the website and the search results.
Here's a quick breakdown of the "
active
" status values:
1
=
Inactive
(as in they signed up for a free account but have not verified their email address)
2
=
Active
3
=
Cancelled
/
Account Closed
4
=
On Hold
(usually the status an Admin would assign to temporarily suspend an account)
5
=
Past Due
Remember, you can always change a member's active status later from the admin dashboard.

title: Post Types API - How to Edit Post Types Data with API Calls
content:
Using the API there are 5 Post Type actions that can be achieved:
GET - /api/v2/data_categories/get/{data_id}
POST - /api/v2/data_categories/create
POST - /api/v2/data_categories/custom_fields
PUT - /api/v2/data_categories/update
DELETE - /api/v2/data_categories/delete
We will break down these actions and explain how to achieve an end results with each one. The examples shown in this article are completed using
https://www.postman.com/
For all actions, add the API Key to the Headers:
1. GET -
/api/v2/data_categories/get/{data_id}
Read the data of a single Post Type based on the Data ID.
Choose
GET
as the method
Replace the {{api_url}} for the website url
Replace the {id} with the actual post type ID
Using this action is simple, add the url above but replace {id} with the actual post type ID. This will fetch the post types information from the website.
2.
POST -
/api/v2/data_categories/create
Add a Post Type to the database.
Choose
POST
as the method
In the Body select
x-www-form-urlencoded
Enter data
3.
POST - /api/v2/data_categories/custom_fields
Get all fields available for the Post Type.
Choose
POST
as the method.
In the Body select
x-www-form-urlencoded
Then add the data_id of the Post Type
4.
PUT - /api/v2/data_categories/update
Update a Post Type record and their related data from the database.
Choose
PUT
as the method
In the Body select
x-www-form-urlencoded
Then add the new data for the Post Type
5. DELETE - /api/v2/data_categories/delete
Use this action URL to delete a Post Type, replace {id} with the Post Type ID that will be removed from the website.
Choose
DELETE
as the method
Replace the {id} with the data_id that will be deleted
In the Params add the data_id to delete

title: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Featured Members
content:
Streaming Featured Members
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Featured Members section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the members selected to display as Featured Members of the website, to learn more about the process of setting up Featured Members, navigate to the following link:
Featured Members on Homepage
Visual Guide of the Streaming Featured Members Settings
This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Featured Members.
1. Featured Members Title
This setting controls the title for this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs.
2. Title Color
This setting controls the title color for the title of this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs.  Click on the color bar to display the color pallet and select the color accordingly.
3. Display Options
This setting control the total amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results.
4. Results Per Row
This setting control the amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section per row. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results.
5. Enable Carousel Slider?
This setting control the layout of the Streaming Members section, if enabled the Streaming section will display as a carousel, with arrows at each side, instead of displaying the Streaming Members in a grid layout, they will appear in the carousel. If set to No, the Streaming Members will be displayed in the default grid view.
6. Hide On Mobile?
This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Members section will display on mobile devices. If enabled this section will not appear on mobile devices. If the setting is set to No, the Streaming Members section will appear on mobile devices accessing the website.
7. Only Show Members with Photo
This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Featured Members section will display members that have already uploaded either a Member Image or Member Logo, but the system will only display the Member Image, not the Member Logo. The options are: "Show All, Even if Member Does Not Have Photo" or "Member Must Have Photo"
8. Display Additional Information
This setting controls the information displayed per member in the Streaming Members section on the homepage of the website. The options to choose from are:
Display About Snippet
Display Top Level Category
Display Sub Level Category
Display Short Description
Do Not Display Additional Information
Display About Snippet

title: Email Limit Boost
content:
Is your membership community growing faster than expected? All Website Plans are allocated 1,500 daily email sends (45,000 free emails each month – for life). The Email Limit Boost removes the 1,500 daily limit and increases your total monthly send limit.
Perfect for Websites That:
Frequently reach the free 1,500 daily limit
Send newsletters to all members and email subscribers
Have high activity levels resulting in a large volume of notification emails
Need to accommodate business growth and reach larger audiences
Get This Boost
Visit our website:
Email Limit Boost
On the website use the slider to
ADD
to the email limit:
Use the "
Add (5,000,10,000,15,000,...) Emails ($x/Mo)
" button to increase the limit:
Current Daily Email Usage
The daily email usage is displayed in the dashboard when scheduling a new email or newsletter.
How Billing Works for Email Limit Boosts
When you purchase an email limit boost, the sending limit for that site increases immediately for the current calendar month.
Example: An email limit boost purchased on June 1st or June 29th will both apply through June 30th. On July 1st, the limits will renew and reset based on the total number of email limit boosts purchased and billed for that month.
The subscription for the email limit boost will be billed in advance on the 1st of each month, covering that month’s email sending limits.
Example: A boost purchased on June 29th will be billed again on July 1st, in advance, when the email limits renew and reset for the new month.
Unused email sends do not carry over to the next month. Each month, the sending limit resets to match the total number of active email limit boosts for that calendar month.
The subscription will continue to auto-renew as a single, consolidated charge per site on the 1st of each month, covering all active email limit boosts.
If you purchase multiple email limit boosts for the same site in a single month:
Each one increases the sending limit right away.
All boosts are consolidated into one subscription billed on the 1st of the following month.
If the consolidated subscription goes past due or cannot be billed on the 1st of the month:
All email limit boosts will be removed from the site.You can repurchase email limit boosts at any time to restore your desired sending limits for the month.
For a customized quote for higher limits, please
CONTACT OUR TEAM
.

title: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Blog Articles
content:
Streaming Blog Articles
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Blog Articles section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the Recent Blog Articles
To edit these settings, navigate to:
In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings
Select Designs Settings
Open The Homepage Tab
Open The Module Select Content to Display
Select The Streaming Blog Articles Option
Visual Guide of the Streaming Blog Articles
This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Blog Articles
1. Recent Blog Articles Title
This setting allows the administrator to set the title for the recent blog articles section. The title can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field.
2. Title Color
The title color setting enables the customization of the title's color. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
3. Display Options
This setting controls the number of recent blog articles displayed. Administrators can select from a range of options, from 1 to 24 results. Additionally, the layout can be adjusted to show a specific number of results per row, ranging from 2 to 4 results per row.
4. Results Per Row
This setting controls the number of recent blog articles displayed per row. Administrators can select from a range of 2 to 4.
5. Enable Carousel Slider
The carousel slider option allows recent blog articles to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off using the provided dropdown menu.
6. Hide On Mobile
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent blog articles section should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
7. Linked Post Type
This setting allows the administrator to select the type of content linked to the recent blog articles. Options include events, job listings, coupons, videos, audio posts, website blog articles, community articles, and discussions.
8. Only Show Posts with Photos
Administrators can choose to display only those posts that have photos. This setting ensures that posts without photos are excluded from the recent blog articles list.
9. Image Quality
This setting controls the quality of the images displayed in the recent blog articles. Administrators can choose between thumbnail size and large size.
10. Show "View All" Button
The "View All" button allows users to see all recent blog articles. This setting can be toggled on or off using the dropdown menu.
11. Hide If No Posts Exist
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent blog articles section should be hidden if no posts exist. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
12. Only Include Posts from Active Members
This setting specifies whether only posts from active members should be included. Administrators can choose to include posts from active members only or from all members.
13. Include Posts from Non-Searchable Members
This setting allows administrators to choose whether to include posts from non-searchable members. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
14. Include Posts from Members in These Plans
This setting allows administrators to limit the displayed posts to specific membership plans. Administrators can select the desired membership plans from the provided list.

title: 05/31/2024 - Software Update
content:
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.
We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the new Send Newsletter functionality in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Only Show Members with Photo" Homepage Section Design Setting from working properly in some cases.
Widget Involved:
Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Members
We implemented a set of small fixes to the Sell Digital Products & Services Add-On.
We made an update to improve the page load and search results speed of the Activity Tracker in the Admin.
We updated the Community Comments Add-On to add the ability to "follow" comment threads and receive email notifications when new comments or replies are posted to followed threads. Click
here
for more information.
Widget Involved:
Bootstrap Theme - Function - Comment Handling
Email Template Involved:
post-comment-reply-notification
We updated the "Recommended Size" text
for the Default Member Cover image on the General Settings page in the Admin
to display the values selected in the Image Settings.
We created a new page in the Admin called Email Outbox. This page will log all emails sent by the system.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the pagination links on the Search Members page in the Admin after performing a search using the "Find Duplicates" filter in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing some video post thumbnail from displaying on the Manage Posts page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from showing the correct lead status in the success message after performing a bulk update action on the Member Leads page in the Admin in some cases.

This setting controls the number of recent products displayed. Administrators can select from a range of options, from 1 to 24 results. Additionally, the layout can be adjusted to show a specific number of results per row, ranging from 2 to 4 results per row.
4. Enable Carousel Slider
The carousel slider option allows recent products to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off using the provided dropdown menu.
5. Hide On Mobile
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent products section should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
6. Linked Post Type
This setting allows the administrator to select the type of content linked to the recent products. Options include classified, photo album, property, product.
7. Only Show Posts with Photos
Administrators can choose to display only those posts that have photos. This setting ensures that posts without photos are excluded from the recent products list.
8. Image Quality
This setting controls the quality of the images displayed in the recent products. Administrators can choose between thumbnail size and large size.
9. Show "View All" Button
The "View All" button allows users to see all recent products. This setting can be toggled on or off using the dropdown menu.
10. Hide If No Posts Exist
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the recent products section should be hidden if no posts exist. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
11. Only Include Posts from Active Members
This setting specifies whether only posts from active members should be included. Administrators can choose to include posts from active members only or from all members.
12. Include Posts from Non-Searchable Members
This setting allows administrators to choose whether to include posts from non-searchable members. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
13. Include Posts from Members in These Plans
This setting allows administrators to limit the displayed posts to specific membership plans. Administrators can select the desired membership plans from the provided list.
14. Display Order
The display order setting determines the order in which recent products are shown. Options include newest first, oldest first, and random order. This can be customized by selecting the desired option from the dropdown menu.
15. Limit One Post per Member?
This setting specifies whether only one post per member should be displayed. Administrators can choose to display one post per member or allow multiple posts from the same member.

title: Changelog - May 2024
content:
New Features:
We added the ability to upload .txt and .rtf files
through the Media Manager in the Admin and "File Upload" fields in the Form Manager
.
We added a new default CSS class called "btn-outline". This class will add an "outlined button" style when applied to elements on a site.
We added a new unique default CSS class to each row in the table that displays data in the "Overview" tab on member profile pages. This CSS class is dynamically named based on the Database Variable Name of the corresponding field in the member form that is displaying the data on the member profile page.  This will make targeting specific form fields displayed in the Overview tab of profile pages much easier.
We released the new version of the Send Newsletter module in the Admin - click
here
for more information.
We created two new Homepage Design Settings called "Display Star Rating" and "Only Display Members with Star Ratings?" for the Recent and Featured Member widgets used on the homepage.
The "Display Star Rating" setting will control whether or not a member's review Star Rating will display on the homepage widgets. The
"Only Display Member with Star Ratings?" setting will require members to have a review score in order for them to display in the widget.
We created a new Advanced Setting called "Website Homepage URL". This setting controls the URL of the homepage of the website (/home by default).
We updated the Sell Digital Products & Services Add-On to add the ability to support recurring subscriptions and donation payments in addition to the one-time and free payments. Click
here
for more information.
We updated the Community Comments Add-On to add the ability to "follow" comment threads and receive email notifications when new comments or replies are posted to followed threads. Click
here
for more information.
We created a new page in the Admin called Email Outbox. This page will log all emails sent by the system.
Enhancements / Fixes:
We implemented an security update to the Admin Login page.
The system will now always send an email notification when an Admin selects the option to send an email notification when updating the status of a review from the Member Reviews page in the Admin.
We updated the display of reviews on the Member Profile and Reviews Search Results pages to not show an image when the user that left the review is not a member of the site.
We updated the Member Billing page in the Member Dashboard to always show the "Billing Address" button, even if the member does not have a credit card on file.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from returning the correct amount of "Eligible Members for Geocode Method" when switching between the different geocoding methods on the Member Geocode page in the Admin.
We updated the way we store Admin account cookies when logging in to the Admin area to prevent more cookies than necessary from being stored.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to match leads to members in bulk on the Match Lead page in the Admin in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from importing the last sub or sub-sub category in a member category CSV field in some cases.
We added the ability to save "[me=xxxx]" shortcodes in menu link fields in the Menu Manager.
We updated the Member Snapshot area on the Admin Dashboard to display the number of members who "Joined Today" in addition to the previous 7 and 30 days.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "pretty URL" member search results pages for the the country "
Côte d'Ivoire" from working properly in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from updating an invoice to the "Paid" status after successfully creating a subscription manually from the Admin when using Stripe as the Payment Gateway in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability for members to view their own Review detail pages when the "Prevent Reviews for Own Profile" Advanced Setting was active in some cases.
We implemented an update in order to prevent the Google Maps JS files from being loaded twice on the Search Members page in the Admin.
We updated the location search on the Search Members page in the Admin to provide better results when searching by state or country.
We deprecated the Facebook Website Chat Add-On. Click
here
for more information.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Google Maps Search Results Add-On from working properly when the "Enable Search Results Cache" Post Type Setting was active.
We updated the
highlight color of custom webhooks
on the Webhooks Page in the Admin.
We added validation to prevent non-decimal values when updating the "Default Center Map Location" Advanced Setting in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Post Category dropdowns from working properly on Post Search Results pages when the "Sidebar Position on Mobile Devices" Post Setting is set to "Top" in some cases.
The new Send Newsletter functionality is now compatible with emojis.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Google Maps logic from working properly after performing a search for a state or province that shares its name with a city in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from respecting the "Make Location Fields Required?" Lead Setting when submitting the "Website - Lead Form - Get Matched" form in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Admin Roles logic from working as expected in some cases.
We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the new Send Newsletter functionality in the Admin.
We updated the Manage Posts page in the Admin to show a confirmation modal when a post is set to be Published by an Admin but doing so would cause the member to surpass the Max. Free Post limit set in their Membership Plan settings.
The emails sent by the system after submitting the Contact Us form is now compatible with the "Website 'From' Email Address" Setting.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to search by keywords on the Match Leads page in the Admin. We also updated the category dropdowns on the Match Leads page to make them keyword-searchable dropdown.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Search Members page in the Admin from returning accurate results after performing a search using the "Complete Profile" option in combination with the Location field in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Member Search Results page on the frontend from returning accurate results when using the "Dynamic Category Filtering" Add-On while the "Dynamic Category Filter - Broad Match" Advanced Setting was deactivated in some cases.
We made several small bug fixes and improvements to the new Send Newsletter functionality in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Only Show Members with Photo" Homepage Section Design Setting from working properly in some cases.
We implemented a set of small fixes to the Sell Digital Products & Services Add-On.
We made an update to improve the page load and search results speed of the Activity Tracker in the Admin.
We updated the "Recommended Size" text
for the Default Member Cover image on the General Settings page in the Admin
to display the values selected in the Image Settings.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the pagination links on the Search Members page in the Admin after performing a search using the "Find Duplicates" filter in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing some video post thumbnail from displaying on the Manage Posts page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from showing the correct lead status in the success message after performing a bulk update action on the Member Leads page in the Admin in some cases.
In all,
over 60 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.

title: Emails » Email Outbox
content:
This article will guide us on using the Email Outbox functionality in our software. Learn how to access and utilize this tool to engage with the audience effectively.
How to Access This Tool
This tool can be accessed under
Emails » Email Outbox
in the admin area:
Overview of the Layout
In this section, the Email Outbox layout will be outlined and explained. This includes additional resources and details of the different statuses, activities, and information that is displayed.
Status
Two different banners can be displayed based on the status of the emails sent from the system:
Sent:
The email has been sent out.
Not Sent:
The email has not been sent out.
Date
The emails sent date and time will be displayed here:
Sent By
The email account of the sender will be displayed:
The default Website "FROM" Email Address can be set up under
General Settings » General Settings Tab » Website "FROM" Email Address.
Recipient
This section displays the recipient email address, along with any CC and BCC recipients:
Email Content
In this section, the Email Template used will be displayed.
Within this segment, both the Email Templates name and the option to click "
See Email
" for a preview of the email will be available:
Activity
Email activity will be displayed in this column, it includes activity for the main email recipient as well, as any other CC/BCC:
Email Status
Different status will show:
Delivered:
Emails are successfully sent to the server.
Unopened:
The recipient might not have read the email or deleted the email without opening it.
Opened:
Number of times the recipients have opened the email.
Clicked
:
Interaction of the recipients clicking on a link in the emails.
Spam Complaints:
Reports made by email recipients against the emails sent from the site.
Failed:
The email address entered is not valid.
Hard Bounced:
This occurs when the recipient's mail server permanently rejects an email due to reasons like invalid email addresses or domain issues.
Soft Bounced:
It happens when an email cannot be delivered temporarily, often due to reasons like a full mailbox or a temporary issue with the recipient's server.
Previously Bounced:
This refers to email addresses that have experienced either a hard or soft bounce in previous delivery attempts, indicating a history of delivery issues that should be monitored or addressed.
The date and time of each Activity will also be displayed next to each status:
Email Source
This will display what triggered the email:
Admin Sent:
The email was manually sent using the
Emails » Compose Emails
functionality.
Signup
:  Triggered by a Signup / Welcome email.
API
: Email sent by the API.
Newsletter
: Newsletter submissions.
Billing Upgrade / Update:
Complete an upgrade or update credit card.
Password Reset.
Email Verification.
Lead Message / Lead Complete and Lead Match.
Contact Form and Feedback
Recommendation:
Reviews
(No Label)
: Triggered by a custom widget or code.
Exploring Additional Functionality
Some additional functionality is available within the Email Outbox. Here, users can filter options and convenient actions.
Filter by Status
This option enables users to filter the Outbox by the email status, such as Sent, Not Sent, Delivered, Unopened, Opened, Clicked, Spam Complaints, and Failed.
Filter by Date
Users can arrange sent emails chronologically, aiding in tracking and managing sent emails over time.
Filter by Keyword
This feature facilitates searching for specific sent emails by keywords, streamlining navigation within the system.

title: Instant Business Data
content:
Rapidly populate the directory with relevant, up-to-date business records. The Instant Business Data service enables the ability to search for businesses by industry, location, and other criteria, then instantly import them to the website as listings.
EVERY BD SITE STARTS WITH
100
FREE CREDITS!
Key Features & Benefits
:
Instantly populate the directory with business listings
Choose businesses based on Category and Location
Immediate content boost for new and existing websites
Helps any website appear more established and credible
Enormous cost-savings compared to other data providers
Get This Boost
Visit our website:
Instant Business Data
Business Import Credits
Business Import Credits serve as the key to acquiring individual records, with these credits being offered in a range of quantities. Each purchase, whether it's 1,000 or 10,000 credits, is designed to cater to different business needs, ensuring flexibility and scalability.
When a user opts to purchase, say, 10,000 business imports, these credits are then allocated to one of their owned websites. This streamlined process allows for efficient management and application of the credits, ensuring that the website benefits directly from the import capabilities.
EVERY BD SITE STARTS WITH
100
FREE CREDITS!
ADD 1,000 CREDITS
ADD 5,000 CREDITS
ADD 10,000 CREDITS
ADD 25,000 CREDITS
Data Accuracy Disclosure
The business data importer tool strives to provide accurate data.
The purpose of this tool is to add business listings so the site appears populated and established.
Due to the dynamic nature of business data,
some details, such as logo images, may be unavailable
.
This tool is not intended as a source for email addresses.
If available, emails are not guaranteed to work.
To conserve credits, the system skips duplicate records already
imported by this tool
, but not from other sources.
To ensure the data meets the website's needs,
test with a smaller import of
10 records first
before initiating larger imports.
Importing Business Data
Import data directly from the admin dashboard once the credits have been added to the website.
Go to
My Members
Click on
Business Data
Import Credits
Add Import Credits on this page, the button will redirect to the following URL:
Add Instant Business Data Credits
Filters
Within this tab, users can search for records that align with any Business Category in any Location. Each click refines the search, progressively narrowing the sample size of the results.
The resulting records will be displayed on the same page, providing a seamless and convenient user experience.
Select Business Category
This filter allows admins to select from Main and Specific categories using the drop downs.
Main Category
Specific Category
Match Options
There are two additional filter options for the categories that can focus or broaden the results.
Primary Category Match
*Focused Search *Fewer Results
:
This search option narrows results to only include businesses listed under a specific primary category. For example, when searching for "Pizza Restaurant," only businesses with "Pizza Restaurant" as their primary category will be found. Use this option for precise and targeted search results.
R
elated Category Match
*Broader Search *More Results
:
This search option expands results by including businesses in both the primary and related categories. For example, a business listed under "Pizza Restaurant" may also appear in searches for "Restaurant" or "Pizza Shop." Choose this option to find a wider range of related businesses.
Business Name
This is an optional filter and there are 3 additional options.
Exact Name Match:
Finds exact name matches only.
Partial Name Match
: Finds names containing the keyword.
Does Not Match:
Excludes names with the keyword.
Enter Location/Region
The location search is powered by Google making it easy and convenient to search all regions. If the website language is different than english, a checkbox option has been added to enable searching in the website's language, providing more comprehensive results based on the commonly used language versions in specific regions.:
Important:
To get results only from a specific location, enter the
EXACT
postal code or city name. Searching by country or state will return results from the entire area. Searching by county is only supported for the USA, for other countries a pop-up will show indicating to enter a specific location.
For locations in
Taiwan
, we encourage to search for zip codes or the entire country. Searching for cities will return a warning modal:
"
Specific Location Required:
For Taiwan, please input a specific postal code location for the most accurate results. Cities, counties, and states are not supported at this time.
"
It is required to select a Google Location Suggestion in order to search.
If a location is typed in without a Google suggestion being selected, an error message will appear:
"INVALID LOCATION: Enter a proper postal code, city or state, AND THEN select an option from the suggestions."
To ensure satisfaction with results, test imports with 10 credits first.
Preferred Attributes
Select the
preferred
attributes to be included. Please note that while the system will attempt to include all details, some attributes may not always be available.
Email Address
Phone Number
Website URL
Updated Last 30 Days
Duplicate Company Name Handling
The
Duplicate Company Name Handling
option, located under Preferred Attributes, helps prevent duplicate business listings during imports. When enabled, the admin can choose how duplicate company names are handled before records are imported.
Choose one of the following options:
Import All Records (Allow Duplicate Names)
(Default)
– Imports all matching businesses, including duplicate company names.
Skip If Company Name Already Exists on Website
– Checks the website for an existing business with the same company name and skips importing duplicate matches.
Prevent Duplicate Names Within This Import Only
– Prevents duplicate company names from being imported more than once during the current import session.
If two businesses with the same company name were imported into the directory. Although they have different coordinates, they appear as duplicate listings.
By selecting Skip If Company Name Already Exists on Website, businesses with a company name that already exists on the website will be skipped during future imports, helping reduce duplicate listings and minimizing cleanup after bulk imports.
Note:
Duplicate detection is based on an exact, case-insensitive company name match. Businesses skipped because of duplicate names are not imported and
do not consume Business Data credits
.
Search for Records
Once the records have been narrowed down using the filters, the system can complete the search:
Click on "
Search for Records
"
Scroll down to see the results
Two options will be available: "
Go Back
" or "
Continue to Import Settings
"
The results will display the number of credits available and will allow the user to select how many of the records to import:
Review & Import Records
The results available will need to be reviewed before completing the import.
Total Records Found
: Displays the total number of records detected and available for import from the uploaded data.
Import Credits Available
: Indicates the number of records that can be imported based on the credits currently available on the account.
Maximum Imports
: Shows the maximum number of records permitted in this import batch, determined by the available credits.
How many records to import?
: Specify the number of records to include in this import. The selected amount cannot exceed the maximum allowed.
"
Continue to Import -->
": Starts the import process for the selected records.
Import Settings
The
Import Settings
include:
Assign Records to a Membership Plan
Select from the existing plans
Set Member Status
Active or Inactive
Assign Tag to Identify Members After Import
Create and assign a new tag if needed.
Assign Members to a Category
The system can add these new members to one of the following options
Assign Members to Existing Category (No New Category Created)
Create a Top Category (If Name Does Not Exist)
Create Sub or Sub-Sub Categories (If Name Does Not Exist)
The category that was searched won't be automatically created in the directory unless the create top or sub / sub-sub categories is selected.
Confirm Import
Once the settings have been defined, complete the import:
Confirm the
Data Import
:
The system will generate an
Import Summary:
Clicking on "
View Import Progress
" will redirect the users to the
My Imports
tab.
My Imports
This tab shows the results of all queued, processing, and completed imports.
Queued and processing imports appear at the top, while completed imports are listed in descending order based on the import ID.
This includes:
Import ID
: Displays the unique identifier assigned to each import batch.
Actions
: View Records & Download List
Status
: Indicates the current state of the import, such as processing, complete, or available for reimport.
Criteria
: Summarizes the filters and data points used to generate the import, including category and location.
Find Logos
: Shows the progress of the logo retrieval task for the imported records.
Geocode Records
: Displays the status of converting record addresses into map-ready geographic coordinates.
Total Completed Imports
: Reflects the number of records successfully imported compared to the total requested.
NOTE:
Once the import is in the queue it's ok to continue with other tasks in the admin, the import will continue processing in the background.
Sort Filters
Use the available filters and search tools to quickly locate, sort, and manage import records.
Sort By
: Organizes import records based on the selected criteria, such as ID, date, or record volume.
ID or Keyword
: Searches for imports using a specific import ID or related keyword.
Location Name
: Filters imports by the location associated with the records.
Assigned Category
: Displays imports mapped to a specific category.
Any Status
: Filters imports by their current progress, including complete, processing, or reimport availability.
Filter by Date
: Limits results to imports created within a selected date range.
Select
Reset
at any time to clear the filters and return to the full list before running a new search.
View Records
Clicking on "
View Records
" will display the imported members in the
Search Members
list:
Download List
The"Download List" option allows to
export the results
into a .csv file.
Reimport Data
When previously imported data has been deleted from the site for whatever reasons, a button with the option to "Reimport Data" will appear in the Status column:
When reimporting data, the system will prompt the admin to assign the categories once more. . If category options are available, all three levels can be assigned.
Once the categories have been selected, the data will import again:
About Me
To help with SEO and avoid duplicate content warnings, a unique content blurb about the business is included with each record.
Important Note
The system does not import images for members assigned to a plan that does not support logo or profile photos.
Data Search Tips
This video provides a step-by-step guide on how to find more business records, offering practical tips and tools to enhance search results and uncover additional data:
Find More Business Records – Instant Business Data Search Tips
FAQ
Where is the data from and how is it sourced?
We’ve partnered with data providers that aggregate business information from various public and commercial sources worldwide. Our providers use advanced technologies and methodologies to compile this information, ensuring its accuracy and relevance.
Is the data safe to use?
Yes, the data is safe to use. Our data providers adhere to strict data privacy and security standards to ensure that all information is handled responsibly and ethically.
How often is the data updated?
The data is updated regularly to ensure that you have the most current information available. The frequency of updates varies depending on the source, but our providers strive to keep the data as up-to-date as possible.
Is the data always 100% accurate?
While we strive to provide the most accurate and up-to-date information, minor discrepancies may sometimes exist due to the dynamic nature of business data. If you encounter widespread issues with the data, please contact our customer support team for assistance.
What types of businesses are included in the listings?
Our listings cover over 5,000 business categories from worldwide locations, ensuring comprehensive coverage for various industries.
How do I integrate the data into my site?
Integrating the data is simple and efficient. The system will automatically add the business data as listings on your site with just a few clicks. Additionally, the data can be exported and used in other ways to suit your needs.
Are email addresses included?
While email addresses are not guaranteed to be included, they may occasionally be found and included with the data.
What if a business doesn’t want to be listed on my site?
If a business you’ve imported requests to be removed from your site, it’s best practice to comply with the request and remove the listing. This helps create a safe, transparent, and respectful experience for everyone involved.
Why didn’t all my data get imported?
Business Data import records will be skipped if they have already been imported or if the email field contains a Facebook link instead of a valid email address.

title: Member Tags & Tag Groups
content:
Member Tags are designed to give the website owner more control over member management. With Member Tags, it is possible to add specific tags to members, making it easier than ever to organize and categorize them according to unique criteria.
Key Features
Customizable Tags: Create and assign tags to members based on attributes, behaviors, interests, or any custom parameters.
Smartlists Creation: Group members with similar tags to form dynamic smartlists, allowing for targeted communication and streamlined management.
Enhanced Control: Easily filter, search, and manage members by tags, ensuring quick access to update member information as needed.
Improved Engagement: Tailor interactions and marketing efforts by targeting specific groups, improving engagement and satisfaction.
How to Add Member Tags & Tag Groups
Go to
My Members
Click on
Smart Lists & Tags
Move to the
Member Tags
tab
Click on the
"New Member Tag +"
button
A pop up will show to enter the
Tag name
and select a
Tag Group.
Enter a Tag name
Select a Tag Group
Click on "Yes, Continue" to add the tag
Actions
Once the Tag has been created, it can be deleted or edited. Hover over the
Actions
button to delete the tag:
Edit
Click on Edit to change the name or reassign to a different Tag Group:
Finding the Member Tag ID
To locate the
Member Tag ID
, navigate to the
Member Tags
section in the admin panel. Each tag will be listed along with its corresponding ID number, which can be used for filtering and automation.
Tag Groups
By default, all websites include a default tag group named
Custom Tags
. This core group cannot be edited or deleted.
.
However, additional
Tag Groups
can be added for more granular control.
To add a Tag Group, follow these steps:
Go to
My Members
.
Click on
Smart Lists & Member Tags
Move to the
Tag Groups tab
and click on
"New Tag Group +"
